description:
We’re looking for a creative and highly motivated Social Media Content Creator to join our fast-paced, video-first marketing team. In this role, you'll be responsible for turning long-form videos into a variety of engaging micro-content across platforms like Instagram, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and LinkedIn.

If you love creating memes, Reels, quote cards, captions, and interactive content—and enjoy seeing your work drive

real engagement—this is the perfect role for you.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Repurpose long-form video content into short-form posts, including video clips, graphics, memes, and captions

• Must be based in the Philippines

title: Data Support Analyst
description:
We are looking for a dependable and customer-oriented individual to join our SDS Admin team in a dual-focus role. Roughly half of your time will be spent on SDS management operations — maintaining our Safety Data Sheet database and supporting manufacturer outreach. The other half will focus on customer support and growth for our ISDSS platform, handling user queries through live chat,
, and phone, and contributing to platform content and improvement.



This role is ideal for someone who is organised and detail-oriented, communicates well in English, and is comfortable switching between data tasks and direct user interactions. As ISDSS continues to grow, there is real scope for this role to evolve with it.

• Serve as the first point of contact for ISDSS (
) users via live chat,
, and phone

• Maintain accurate records of SDS activity and support interactions

• Log and track support queries to help identify trends and measure performance

• Contribute to regular team reporting as needed



QUALIFICATIONS

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English

• Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy

• Customer service mindset with a professional and approachable manner

• Organised and reliable with good time management

• Comfortable working independently and as part of a remote team

title: Content Manager for Golf Creator (Long-Term Position)
description:
Content Manager & Video Editor (Long-Term)



About Me:

My name is Trace Martin.



I'm a professional golf coach building an online education business that helps golfers improve through simple, easy-to-understand instruction.



My goal is to build one of the world's best online golf education platforms through short-form content, online courses, and 1-on-1 coaching.



I'm looking for someone who wants to grow with the business for years, not just complete a few editing projects.



---



## Position



I'm looking for a reliable **Content Manager & Video Editor** to take ownership of everything that happens after I finish filming.



My goal is to spend my time coaching, filming, and creating new ideas while you help organize, edit, publish, and manage the content.



This is a long-term remote position.



---



## Responsibilities



### Video Editing



* Edit Instagram Reels

* Edit TikTok videos

* Edit YouTube Shorts

* Edit YouTube videos (eventually)

* Add captions

* Add music when appropriate

* Add graphics and simple animations

* Create engaging hooks

* Improve pacing and viewer retention



### Content Management



* Schedule content across platforms

* Upload videos to social media

* Upload lessons to Skillest

* Repurpose long-form videos into shorter clips

* Repurpose Reels into Skillest lessons

* Organize Google Drive folders

* Organize video files

* Keep projects organized and easy to find



### Growth



As we grow, I'd love for this role to expand into:



* Thumbnail creation

* Basic graphic design

* YouTube management

*
 marketing support

* Course uploads

* SOP documentation

* Workflow improvements

* Content ideas



---



## What I'm Looking For



Someone who is:



* Reliable

* Organized

* Communicates well

* Detail-oriented

* Proactive

* Willing to learn

* Excited to build something long-term



Golf knowledge is **not required**, but it's a bonus.



---



## Software Experience (Preferred)



Experience with some or all of these is helpful:



* CapCut

* Premiere Pro

* Final Cut Pro

* Canva

* Google Drive

* Notion

* Publer

* Skillest (can be taught)



---



## Work Hours



Flexible.



Initially, this will likely be a part-time position (10–20 hours per week), with the opportunity to grow into a larger role as the business expands.



---



## What Success Looks Like



My ideal workflow is simple:



I film.



I upload the raw footage.



You take care of everything else.



That includes editing, organizing, scheduling, uploading, and helping keep the content machine running smoothly.



---



## To Apply



Please include:



1. A short introduction about yourself.

2. Your location and time zone.

3. Links to 3–5 videos you've edited.

4. What editing software do you use.

5. Why you'd be a good fit for this role.

6. Your hourly rate (USD).

7. Your availability each week.



**Bonus:** Tell me one thing you would improve about my current social media content. I value people who notice details and think proactively.



I'm looking for someone who wants to become an important part of this business and help build something meaningful over the long term.

title: Influencer Marketing VA | $1,500/mo | Full-Time, Weekends Off
description:
At Luma, a winning UGC ad doesn't start with the editing. It starts with the right creator, briefed right, delivered on time.



We're a creative performance agency for DTC brands, capped at 10 clients. Quality over quantity. We make the ads that win on Meta and scale our clients.



We're looking for a UGC CREATOR MANAGER to own our creator pipeline end to end, long-term. Someone who has already managed real UGC campaigns for e-commerce, knows the sourcing platforms, and thinks performance before vanity.



What you'll own:



- Source US-based UGC creators that match a brief and a customer avatar (we give you the avatar, or you build it from the marketing data we provide)

- Outreach, negotiation, deals: rates, deliverables, deadlines

- Creator payments, clean trackers

- Shipping coordination: collect addresses, send them to the client, track every package until delivery

- Send the briefs (already written by our team) and keep every collab on schedule

- Follow up hard. Creators go silent. You bring them back without burning the relationship.

- Receive the content and QA it against the brief: naming, framing, script, shot list, image and sound

- Approve it or send back precise revision requests

- Drop validated content in the right folder and update the tracker so the editing team can cut it



Who you are:



- Real experience in UGC or influencer coordination for e-commerce (agency or brand side)

- You've used platforms like Insense, Fiverr, Billo, Collabstr, Upwork. Organic DM sourcing on Instagram or others is a big plus.

- Excellent written English. Your outreach messages sell.

- Organized to the extreme. Trackers, naming conventions, deadlines: your comfort zone.

- Marketing sense: you can tell if a video will perform as an ad before anyone edits it

- You take initiative and ask the right questions before problems become urgent

- You can run several brands and 10+ creator collabs in parallel



What we offer:



- $1,500/month

- Full-time: 7 hours a day, Monday to Friday

- Long-term. Committed. Looking for a home, not a side gig.

- We can show proof: we pay our people well, and on time.



To apply: tell us about the last UGC campaign you ran (brand or niche, number of creators, platforms used, results) and send a 2 min loom about your motivation to join us. (start the loom with "Hey lets scale together")



Ps: We can scale together. I want to build a team of navy seals. If you are good and want to have a good rewarding environment, give it a try. Its the place to be.



Luma agency in few words:

Clients: 10 - 8M revenue per month

Team: 15 members: video editor / Graphic designer / Creative strategist

Mindset: Performance, Ownership, No BS, Creativity, Winner.

title: Photographer and Social Media Specialist
description:
# JOB OFFER – SMART GALAXY



**Position:** Content Creator & Social Media Specialist

**Work Location:** Smart Galaxy – Izki, Sultanate of Oman



## Salary & Benefits



* **Monthly Salary:** OMR 150, approximately **USD 390**.

* **Accommodation:** Provided free of charge.

* **Water & Electricity:** Fully included and free of charge.



## Working Hours



The store operates in two shifts:



**Morning:** 8:30 AM – 1:30 PM

**Evening:** 4:00 PM – 10:30 PM



The employee is required to work **only 8 hours per day**.



The employee may arrange suitable working hours between the morning and evening shifts, in coordination with the management and according to the needs of the business.



We highly value **productivity, honesty, dedication, commitment, and responsibility**. Our focus is on the quality of work, achievement, and results — not simply attendance.



## Annual Leave



For every completed year of employment, the employee will receive:



* **One full month of paid annual leave.**

* A **paid round-trip flight ticket** to the employee’s home country.

* **Transportation/taxi expenses to and from the airport** covered by the employer.



The employee will continue to receive the **full monthly salary during the annual leave**.



## Main Responsibilities



* Manage and develop Smart Galaxy’s accounts on **Instagram, TikTok, Snapchat, and YouTube**.

* Prepare and organize a regular content and publishing plan across all social media platforms.

* Professionally photograph and showcase store products in an attractive way.

* Create and film **product unboxing videos**.

* Test products and explain their main features and specifications in a simple and engaging way.

* Create, film, and edit creative short-form videos for social media platforms, with each video **not exceeding 40 seconds**.

* Edit photos and videos and prepare them for publishing.

* Publish content regularly and consistently.

* Develop fresh and creative ideas for content, promotions, advertisements, and marketing campaigns.

* Help increase **followers, views, reach, and engagement** across Smart Galaxy’s social media accounts.

* Help turn social media engagement and customer inquiries into **actual sales**.

* Maintain the professional image, brand identity, and reputation of **Smart Galaxy** across all published content.



## Requirements & Skills



* Good experience in **photography, content creation, and short-form video editing**.

* Ability to professionally photograph and film products using a smartphone.

* Good knowledge of **Instagram, TikTok, Snapchat, and YouTube**.

* Good communication and customer interaction skills through social media platforms.

* **Preferably able to speak, read, and write in Arabic**, especially for creating content, writing promotional text, and communicating with customers.

* Good communication skills in English.

* Creative and able to develop fresh and engaging content ideas.



## What We Expect



We are looking for someone who is **creative, honest, dedicated, responsible, committed, and motivated to achieve results**.



We do not measure success only by the number of hours spent at work. We value **quality of content, productivity, results, growth in engagement, and contribution to sales**.



Our goal is to build a **stable and long-term working relationship** based on trust, mutual respect, honesty, commitment, and achievement.



We want the employee to grow professionally with **Smart Galaxy** and become an important part of the company’s continued growth and success.

title: Looking for a Hardcore Star Trek Fan for AI Portrait QA & Customer Support
description:
I'm building a Star Trek-inspired personalized portrait business where customers upload photos and receive custom AI-generated Starfleet portraits printed on canvas.



I'm looking for someone who is a genuine, knowledgeable Star Trek fan who can help ensure every portrait feels authentic and delight customers.



This is an ongoing role with room to grow.





Responsibilities

1. Portrait Quality Control (Primary)



Review every generated portrait before it is sent to the customer.



Check for:



Correct Star Trek era selected

Appropriate uniform style

Correct division colors

Rank insignia consistency

Correct communicator badge

Era-appropriate backgrounds

Missing or incorrect accessories

AI mistakes (extra fingers, distorted faces, strange anatomy, etc.)

Overall visual quality



When needed:



Write small prompt adjustments

Request a regeneration

Recommend manual fixes

2. Customer Support



Reply to customer questions such as:



Order updates

Revision requests

Shipping questions

General product inquiries



Friendly English is required.

Check that:



Correct canvas size

Correct customer names

Correct options selected

Print file looks good



Submit orders to Printify.



4. Canon Accuracy Advisor



When customers specifically request canon accuracy:



Review details such as:



Uniform era

Rank insignia

Division colors

Communicator badges

Shoulder details

Collar style



Suggest prompt improvements where appropriate.



Requirements



You should:



Be a genuine Star Trek fan

Have watched multiple Star Trek series and films

Notice canon inaccuracies that casual fans would miss

Have excellent written English

Midjourney

Flux

GPT prompting

Photoshop

Canva

Shopify

Printify

Customer support



This is NOT for you if...

• Zapier, Make, Shopify Flow, tags, metafields, or note attributes as needed



Applicants may recommend a better option if they explain the benefit, cost, Shopify limitations, and monthly expense.



BUILD PHASES



Provide estimated hours and cost for each phase below.



PHASE 1 — EXISTING-SYSTEM AUDIT

Review the current retailer application, automatic approval, Dealer ID/tag attribution, Shopify setup, and installed apps. Confirm what already works and identify only what must be connected, corrected, or preserved.



PHASE 2 — NEW RETAILER / EXISTING RETAILER SELECTION

Create the starting choice for sales reps:

• New Retailer routes to the existing retailer application while preserving the correct sales-rep referral code.

• Existing Retailer allows selection of an approved retailer and continues directly to order entry.

• Duplicate retailer records must be prevented.



PHASE 3 — ORDER-ENTRY FORM

Build the sales-rep order form to capture:

• Retailer

• Products and quantities

• Approved pricing

• Shipping information

• Sales-rep attribution



The completed form must pass the correct information into Shopify.



PHASE 4 — SHOPIFY DRAFT ORDER AUTOMATION

Create the Shopify Draft Order, attach the correct retailer, preserve sales-rep attribution, reserve inventory, and prepare the order for invoicing.



PHASE 5 — AUTOMATIC SHIPPING

Configure and test the best method to calculate and apply shipping automatically to Draft Orders. Explain any required app, API, Shopify-plan limitation, fallback process, and monthly cost. Staff should only review shipping exceptions.



PHASE 6 — INVOICE AND ACH SETUP

Configure the Shopify Draft Order invoice
 and Order Printer Pro PDF.



The invoice must include:

• Order details

• Shipping

• Taxes

• Total due

• ACH instructions

• PDF invoice link



ACH must be the only payment method presented. Remove customer-facing checkout buttons and links such as Confirm Order, Complete Your Purchase, Pay Now, and Visit Our Store.



PHASE 7 — PAYMENT AND FULFILLMENT CONTROLS

Keep fulfillment blocked until ACH payment is confirmed. Define the staff process for marking the order paid and releasing it to fulfillment. Staff should review exceptions only.



PHASE 8 — TESTING

Test the complete workflow on desktop and mobile, including:

• New Retailer routing

• Existing Retailer selection

• Automatic approval

• Duplicate prevention

• Sales-rep attribution is present on the Draft Order and persists through conversion to the completed order

• Draft Order creation

• Automatic shipping

• Invoice
 and PDF

• Inventory reservation

• ACH confirmation and mark-paid workflow

• Commission reporting



PHASE 9 — SOP AND HANDOFF

Provide:

• Written staff SOP

• Screen-recorded walkthrough

• Administrator handoff



All accounts, automations, and documentation must be owned by Space Cannon.



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE



• Shopify Draft Orders

• Shopify wholesale workflows

• Shopify Flow, tags, metafields, or note attributes

• Zapier, Make, or similar automation

• Automatic shipping-rate calculation

• Shopify notification Liquid

• Order Printer Pro

• Sales-rep attribution and commission reporting

• ACH/manual-payment workflows



PROPOSAL REQUIREMENTS



Please include:

• Your recommended approach and any improvements to the workflow

• Any Shopify, app, API, or plan limitations

• What computer will you use for this project? Include the model, processor, RAM, and operating system. Also list the development tools, automation platforms, and AI subscriptions you currently use and expect to use for this build.

• Expected monthly shopify 3rd party app costs

• Estimated hours and cost for each of the nine phases

• Your hourly rate, total estimated hours, and fixed-price quote

• Timeline by phase and earliest start date

• Two relevant examples of similar Shopify or automation work



Architecture review must be included in the proposal. We are not paying a separate architecture-validation fee.



TO APPLY



Use the subject line: SPACE CANNON SHOPIFY B2B BUILD



Applications that do not follow these instructions may not be reviewed.

Leadify is an Australian lead generation company running high-volume, performance-driven campaigns. This role has direct visibility into revenue-driving work. description:

This is not a role for someone who simply executes instructions.

We are looking for a self-starter who can identify opportunities, challenge assumptions, analyze data, and proactively recommend improvements. You will work closely with operations, product, design, customer service, and technical teams to build meaningful customer experiences and measurable business results.

Customer Lifecycle Management

• Design and optimize customer journeys from onboarding through long-term retention. 

• Develop engagement strategies for new, active, at-risk, and dormant customers. 

• Build and improve customer lifecycle campaigns.

title: Technical Marketing Graphic Designer - Public Safety, Military and Emergency Communications
description:
We are a U.S.-based manufacturer of specialized communications equipment used by military organizations, public-safety agencies, emergency-management teams, government customers, and industrial users.



We are seeking a skilled graphic designer who can create serious, credible, technically accurate marketing and product materials. We are looking for a long-term creative partner who can help establish and maintain a consistent visual identity across our technical documents, advertising, website, presentations, trade shows, and digital marketing.



This is not a general social-media design position.



Our products are technical, and our customers expect clarity, accuracy, professionalism, and an understanding of operational environments. The visual style must appeal to military, public-safety, emergency-management, industrial, and government audiences - not consumer or lifestyle markets.



Projects may include:

Product brochures and sell sheets

Capability statements

Technical manuals and installation guides

Downloadable customer forms and checklists

Fillable PDF documents

Product configuration and quote-request worksheets

Website graphics and banners

LinkedIn advertisements and downloadable social-media content

Trade-show and conference materials

Technical diagrams, product callouts, icons, and illustrations

Presentation graphics and PowerPoint presentations

Product-image cleanup and retouching

Comparison charts and application graphics

Product launch materials

Print-ready and web-ready PDFs

Short product and demonstration videos

LinkedIn video clips

Trade-show videos

Basic training and instructional videos



Required Software Skills

Applicants should have professional experience with:

Adobe InDesign for brochures, product sheets, manuals, capability statements, forms, and multi-page technical documents

Adobe Illustrator for diagrams, technical illustrations, icons, vector graphics, and large-format materials

Adobe Photoshop for product-photo editing, image cleanup, website graphics, and marketing visuals

Adobe Acrobat for preparing, optimizing, and creating downloadable and fillable PDF documents



Experience with Microsoft PowerPoint and Microsoft Word is also important for professional presentations and technical-document formatting.



Preferred Video Skills: Video editing experience is strongly preferred. Helpful programs and capabilities include:

Adobe Premiere Pro

Adobe After Effects

DaVinci Resolve

Camtasia

Basic motion graphics and animation

Editing product demonstrations, training content, trade-show footage, and short social-media videos

Adding titles, captions, transitions, music, voiceover, and branded graphics

Exporting video in the correct formats and dimensions for websites, presentations, LinkedIn, and other digital platforms



Experience with product photography, photo staging, WordPress, or basic HTML/CSS is a plus but is not required.



The work should feel: Professional, Technical, Operational, Clean, Modern, Trustworthy, Accurate, Appropriate for government and defense audiences



We are not looking for trendy social-media templates, overly decorative designs, or consumer-style advertising.



The ideal candidate understands how to make a complex technical product look polished and compelling without changing, obscuring, or misrepresenting the product.



Technical Accuracy and Attention to Detail



Attention to detail is critical.

Product labels, connectors, control names, warning labels, screen displays, buttons, cables, dimensions, and other technical features must remain accurate in all marketing materials.



The designer must be able to improve product photographs and layouts without inventing features, changing equipment details, removing important markings, or creating misleading representations.



The candidate must be able to:

Follow brand and formatting requirements closely, Organize technical information clearly, Maintain consistency across multiple documents and campaigns, Prepare files correctly for print, web, presentations, and social media, Create editable source files that can be updated later, Communicate clearly and ask questions when technical information is uncertain



Please provide relevant examples of:

-Product brochures

-Technical product sheets

-Capability statements

-Technical-document layouts

-Manuals or installation guides

-Downloadable forms or fillable PDFs

-Trade-show graphics

-Presentation materials

-Product-photo editing

-Technical diagrams or infographics

-Short product, training, or promotional videos

-Before-and-after redesign work



Please identify which examples you personally created and which software you used.



Applicants whose portfolios consist mainly of logos, restaurant promotions, fashion graphics, wedding materials, or generic social-media posts may not be a good fit for this position. The goal is not to create the flashiest design. 



The goal is to demonstrate the ability to:

Present technical information clearly

Maintain product accuracy

Follow instructions

Create an appropriate visual style for military, public-safety, and government customers

Deliver organized, editable source files

title: YouTube Shorts Researcher for English Movie/TV Scene Discovery
description:
We are hiring a long-term YouTube Shorts researcher.



This is a research-only role. You will NOT edit videos, write scripts, or upload content. Your job is to find strong-performing English-language live-action movie and TV scenes on YouTube Shorts and submit them in a structured format we provide.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Find English-language live-action movie / TV scene Shorts on YouTube

- Check each clip against a numeric checklist we give you (views, upload timing, how far it outperforms the channel's own recent videos)

- For each clip, answer 3 short questions: what happens in it, what viewers are reacting to (based on the top comments), and what we learn about a person in the scene

- Submit up to 6 findings per day, every working day



WHAT YOU WILL NOT DO

- No video editing, script writing, thumbnails, or uploading



WHAT WE LOOK FOR

- Native or near-native English comprehension

- You must read comments and tell whether people are reacting to the scene itself or only to the actor/show

- You watch English-language shows and films and follow them easily

- You can describe a scene in one plain sentence, with no adjectives or plot summary

- You can follow a written checklist exactly, without improvising

- Consistent daily output. Accuracy matters more than speed.



HOW PAY WORKS

- This role is paid per approved submission, not a fixed monthly salary

- No hourly tracking — work is evaluated by submission quality and checklist compliance

- A typical week of steady work comes out to roughly $60–70

- Full pay rules and submission standards are shared once you start



ROLE DETAILS

- Remote, part-time, ongoing, long-term

- Selected applicants begin with a paid first week using real tasks, and we keep the strongest fit. Everyone is paid normally during this week.



HOW TO APPLY

1. Start your message with the word: SCENE

2. Link one YouTube Short in English that features a live-action movie or TV scene. Sort comments by Top, then:

   (a) Copy 3 comments reacting to what actually happens in the video — not to the creator, actor, or channel

   (b) In one sentence: what are viewers reacting to?

   (c) In one sentence: what do the top comments suggest is driving attention?

3. Name the last English-language show or film you watched. Describe one 
nt from it in one sentence — only what happens, no adjectives.

4. State your available hours per week and how long you plan to stay in this role.



Only applicants who follow all 4 steps will be reviewed.

title: Sales Representative
description:
The Role

We are looking for a hungry, resilient, and highly articulate Outbound Sales Representative to join our remote team on a part-time basis. Your primary goal will be to generate new business leads and book qualified appointments for our agency by reaching out to UK-based businesses.



Commission Structure: 4% per closed web/app project (avg. deal size: £2,000-£3,000 / ~?7,000-?10,000 commission per sale)



You will be the first point of contact for potential clients, pitching our web design, app development, and SEO services. Because you will be speaking directly with UK business owners and decision-makers, a neutral accent, exceptional English, and a confident phone manner are absolutely essential.



Key Responsibilities

• Outbound Prospecting: Identify and research potential B2B clients in the UK who could benefit from a new website, app, or improved SEO.

• Cold Calling &
ing: Execute high-volume outbound campaigns (cold calls,
s, and LinkedIn outreach) to introduce Dorset Tech's services.

• Lead Qualification: Ask the right questions to qualify prospects based on their budget, timeline, and technical needs.

• Appointment Setting: Book qualified discovery calls and consultations for our senior team to close (or, if you have the experience, close them yourself).

• CRM Management: Keep meticulous records of all calls,
s, and follow-ups in our CRM system.



Requirements

• B2B Sales Experience: Proven track record in outbound sales, cold calling, or appointment setting, preferably within the tech, SaaS, or digital agency space.

• Exceptional English: Flawless spoken and written English with a neutral or easily understood accent. You must be comfortable navigating conversations with UK business owners.

• Resilience: You must be comfortable with rejection and possess the drive to keep dialing and following up.

• Tech-Savvy: A basic understanding of web design (WordPress), SEO, and app development so you can speak credibly about our services.

• Availability: Must be available to work from 9:00 AM to 1:00 PM UK time (which is 4:00 PM to 8:00 PM in the Philippines), Monday through Friday.



About Dorset Tech

We are Dorset's number one web design agency, and we are on a mission to disrupt the web design industry. We pride ourselves on offering the lowest rates in the country without compromising on quality, serving over 2,000 active support customers. We build everything from budget pay-monthly sites to full custom Laravel systems and Flutter mobile apps.



Beyond our technical expertise, we are a social enterprise and a carbon-negative company. We power our office with solar energy, drive electric cars, and plant a tree for every review we receive. If you want to sell a product you can genuinely believe in, for a company that cares about its community and the planet, Dorset Tech is the place for you.



Probation Period: Initial schedule will be 4–6 hours daily during probation, with transition to full-time expected within 2 months.



How to Apply

Please apply with your CV and a brief cover letter detailing your previous cold calling or B2B sales experience. Important: Please include a short audio or video recording introducing yourself and giving us a 30-second "mock pitch" of a web design service. Applications without a recording will not be considered.

title: Executive Assistant to the Founder
description:
Executive Assistant to the Founder – Recruitment, Marketing & Business Operations



Full-time | Remote | UK working hours | Self-employed contractor



Role overview

Garry Howling Recruitment is seeking an exceptional, high-calibre Executive Assistant with extensive experience and a substantial, demonstrable track record of providing high-level support directly to a founder, entrepreneur, senior executive or business owner.



This role will only suit an established professional who has already operated as a trusted right hand, taken ownership of complex and commercially important responsibilities and consistently delivered results with minimal supervision.

Garry Howling Recruitment is a specialist recruitment business operating across the UK accountancy profession. We have ambitious plans to build a high-growth, market-leading recruitment business and are assembling an exceptional remote team to support that growth.



Working directly with the Founder, you will be involved across virtually every part of the business, including recruitment, candidate and client outreach, marketing, executive support, administration and business operations.

This is not a conventional or narrowly defined virtual assistant position. You will be expected to understand the wider commercial purpose behind your work, anticipate what needs to happen and take responsibility for ensuring important actions are completed accurately and on time.



The purpose of the role

Your central purpose will be to increase the Founder’s capacity by taking ownership of operational, administrative and growth-related activity across the business.



You will be expected to:

• Protect and organise the Founder’s time.

• Drive candidate, client and prospective client outreach.

• Maintain 
ntum across commercial opportunities, projects and follow-ups.

• Support recruitment delivery and marketing activity.

• Ensure important actions are completed and nothing is overlooked.

• Introduce greater organisation, structure and accountability across the business.

• Become a trusted, commercially aware and highly dependable right hand to the Founder.



Key responsibilities



Executive support and priority management

• Work closely with the Founder to understand immediate and longer-term priorities.

• Maintain clear action lists and ensure agreed tasks are progressed through to completion.

• Manage diary commitments, meetings, reminders and follow-up activity.

• Prepare information and briefing notes ahead of calls and meetings.

• Monitor outstanding actions and proactively chase anything that remains incomplete.

• Identify matters requiring the Founder’s attention before they become problems.

• Turn the Founder’s ideas and instructions into structured, completed actions.

• Draft professional
s, reports, summaries and other business communications.

• Anticipate requirements rather than waiting to be instructed at every stage.

• Ensure important commitments, deadlines and commercial opportunities are not overlooked.

• Constructively challenge priorities where appropriate and help keep the Founder focused on the highest-value activity.



Recruitment and candidate outreach

• Identify and research suitable candidates through LinkedIn, the CRM and other available sources.

• Create accurate, targeted candidate lists for vacancies and recruitment campaigns.

• Undertake candidate outreach through
, LinkedIn and other appropriate channels.

• Monitor responses and ensure interested candidates receive prompt, professional follow-up.

• Arrange candidate calls, interviews and follow-up conversations.

• Request and follow up CVs, identification documents, signed Candidate Terms of Business and other required information.

• Prepare candidate summaries, profiles and initial drafts of candidate marketing materials.

• Maintain consistent contact with active candidates throughout the recruitment process.

• Prevent promising candidate relationships and opportunities from becoming dormant.

• Support candidate mailers and targeted introductions to prospective employers.

• Assist the Founder with vacancy research, candidate matching and recruitment delivery.

• Identify suitable professionals who may not be actively seeking a new position.

• Help deliver an exceptional and highly responsive candidate experience.



Client outreach and business development

• Research accountancy firms, senior decision-makers, vacancies and potential recruitment opportunities.

• Build accurate and commercially relevant prospect lists.

• Support personalised outreach to prospective and existing clients.

• Draft high-quality
s, LinkedIn messages and follow-up communications.

• Monitor responses and ensure every potential opportunity receives prompt attention.

• Follow up unsigned Terms of Business, outstanding vacancy information, interview feedback and other agreed actions.

• Maintain clear records of active opportunities and the next action required.

• Help reactivate dormant clients and develop relationships with new firms.

• Identify vacancies, recruitment requirements and relevant market developments.

• Maintain 
ntum from an initial approach through to the development of an active client relationship.

• Recognise the commercial importance of individual actions and prioritise accordingly.



Marketing and campaign support

• Assist with candidate mailers, vacancy campaigns, newsletters and other marketing activity.

• Support Brevo campaign preparation, segmentation, contact selection and quality control.

• Work closely with the Marketing Manager to ensure campaigns are accurate, timely and commercially focused.

• Gather information for social media content, candidate marketing and client communications.

• Review written materials for grammar, spelling, accuracy, consistency and overall quality.

• Monitor campaign responses and ensure potential opportunities are acted upon.

• Help maintain a consistent pipeline of candidate-led and vacancy-led marketing campaigns.

• Track results and ensure all appropriate follow-up actions are completed.

• Assist with competitor research, market intelligence and content opportunities.

• Help convert marketing activity into meaningful candidate and client conversations.



CRM and information management

• Ensure Vincere records are accurate, complete and current.

• Confirm that candidates, contacts, companies, vacancies and activities are linked correctly.

• Record relevant calls,
s, meetings, notes and agreed actions.

• Ensure vacancies are assigned to the correct client contact before candidate information is submitted.

• Monitor CRM tasks and follow-ups to ensure actions are completed when promised.

• Support data validation, duplicate checking and general CRM accuracy.

• Work with the Administrator to ensure information is recorded consistently and to the required standard.

• Identify missing, inaccurate or outdated information and take responsibility for resolving it.

• Ensure the CRM provides a reliable and commercially useful picture of relationships, activity and opportunities.



Business operations and team coordination

• Act as a central point of coordination between the Founder and other members of the remote team.

• Monitor agreed tasks, deadlines and deliverables.

• Follow up incomplete work and provide clear progress updates.

• Ensure instructions are understood and implemented properly.

• Review work for accuracy and completeness before it reaches the Founder, where appropriate.

• Help create and improve templates, procedures, trackers and operating processes.

• Identify inefficiencies and recommend practical solutions.

• Take ownership of individual projects from initial instruction through to completion.

• Provide support across recruitment, marketing, administration and business operations as priorities evolve.

• Handle confidential candidate, client, financial and commercial information with complete discretion.

• Take accountability for achieving outcomes, rather than simply reporting that activity has been undertaken.



Essential requirements



Applicants must have:

• A bachelor’s degree.

• Absolutely fluent spoken and written English.

• Exceptional English grammar, spelling and attention to detail.

• A substantial and proven track record of supporting a founder, entrepreneur, senior executive or business owner at a high level.

• Demonstrable experience of operating as a trusted right hand.

• Extensive experience as an Executive Assistant, senior virtual assistant, operations executive or in a similarly demanding position.

• Evidence of taking ownership of complex responsibilities from initial instruction through to completion.

• The ability to work independently, exercise sound judgement and deliver results without close supervision.

• The confidence to communicate professionally with UK candidates, clients and senior business leaders.

• Outstanding organisational, administrative and research capabilities.

• Experience using LinkedIn for professional research and outreach.

• The ability to produce exceptionally high-quality business communications.

• The ability to manage multiple competing priorities in a fast-moving environment.

• Strong technology skills and the ability to learn unfamiliar systems quickly.

• A reliable computer, high-speed internet connection and professional home-working environment.

• The ability to work full-time during UK business hours.



Previous experience within recruitment, professional services, marketing, business development or a UK-facing organisation would be highly advantageous.



The person we are looking for



You will be:

• Highly proactive and naturally inclined to take ownership.

• Exceptionally organised, dependable and responsive.

• Commercially aware and interested in how a business generates revenue.

• Comfortable working directly with a fast-moving and ambitious Founder.

• Able to anticipate requirements instead of waiting for every instruction.

• Persistent in following up actions and ensuring they are completed.

• Confident enough to ask questions, challenge inconsistencies and raise concerns.

• Resourceful and capable of finding solutions independently.

• Calm and accurate while managing competing priorities.

• Comfortable working across an extensive and evolving remit.

• Accountable for outcomes, quality and completion.

• Ambitious and interested in developing alongside a growing business.



What success will look like



Success in this position will mean:

• The Founder has more time to concentrate on high-value candidate and client conversations.

• Important actions are completed without repeated reminders.

• Candidate and client enquiries receive fast, professional responses.

• Outreach is consistent, targeted and properly followed up.

• Commercial opportunities are not lost or forgotten.

• CRM information is accurate and commercially useful.

• The remote team operates with greater coordination and accountability.

• Projects progress from initial idea through to full completion.

• Potential problems are identified and addressed early.

• You become a trusted and indispensable member of the business.



The opportunity



This position offers considerable exposure to the operation and growth of an ambitious specialist recruitment business.

For the right individual, it is an opportunity to become the Founder’s trusted right hand, make a meaningful contribution to the growth of the business and assume increasing responsibility as the company develops.



The remit is deliberately broad and will evolve according to the priorities of the business. You must be willing and capable of becoming involved wherever your support can improve organisation, productivity, commercial activity and results.



Application and interview process



To ensure a thorough and consistent selection process, applications will progress through the following stages:

1. Initial application

Submit an up-to-date CV together with a tailored covering letter explaining your experience of directly supporting a founder, entrepreneur, senior executive or business owner. Generic applications will not be considered.

2. Initial shortlisting

Applications will be assessed against the essential requirements, with particular emphasis on relevant experience, written English, career history and evidence of operating as a trusted right hand.

3. Video introduction

Shortlisted applicants will be invited to provide a two-to-four-minute video introduction covering their relevant experience, achievements and reasons for applying.

4. First interview

Selected candidates will attend a video interview focused on their experience, communication skills, judgement, initiative, commercial awareness and suitability for the position.

5. Practical assessment

Candidates progressing beyond the first interview will complete a time-limited practical assessment based on realistic tasks from the role. This may test written communication, research, prioritisation, attention to detail and problem-solving.

6. Final interview

Finalists will attend a further video interview with the Founder to discuss their assessment, working style, expectations and ability to become a trusted right hand.

7. References and contractor offer



Any offer will be subject to satisfactory professional references and agreement of the self-employed contractor terms.



Nature of the engagement

This is a full-time, remote, self-employed contractor position working UK business hours.

The successful candidate will be responsible for their own tax, insurance, equipment and any other obligations arising from self-employment in their country of residence.

Applicants must already possess considerable experience supporting a founder, entrepreneur, senior executive or business owner and be capable of operating as a trusted right hand from the outset.

ssenger, and

Applications without both of the above will not be considered.

etings (usually 3pm CET)

What You'll Do 

- Research our products, industry, competitors, and target audience to develop a deep understanding of what matters most to our customers. 

- Identify content opportunities based on search trends, customer questions, AI search behavior, and emerging industry topics. 

- Work closely with our SEO/AI search specialists to prioritize topics and keywords that support organic growth. 

- Collaborate with subject matter experts (SMEs) to turn technical knowledge into clear, engaging, and authoritative content.

- Blog articles 

- Website copy 

- LinkedIn posts 

- Case studies 

- Product pages 

- Guides and educational resources 

-
 content 

- Video scripts 

- YouTube descriptions 

- Social media copy

We're Looking For Someone Who 

- Has 3+ years of experience in content writing, content marketing, technical writing, journalism, or a related field. 

- Is an exceptional writer with strong editing and proofreading skills. 

- Enjoys researching unfamiliar topics and can quickly become knowledgeable about new industries. 

- Knows how to simplify complex technical or business concepts without losing accuracy. 

- Understands the principles of SEO and is interested in how AI-powered search is changing content discovery. 

- Can independently identify content ideas instead of waiting for assignments. 

- Is comfortable interviewing stakeholders and collaborating with subject matter experts. 

- Has excellent critical thinking and attention to detail. 

- Uses AI as a productivity tool while ensuring every piece of content is accurate, insightful, and genuinely valuable. 



Nice to Have

- Familiarity with AI search optimization (AEO), SEO, and content strategy. 

- Experience using tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, Ahrefs, SEMrush, Surfer SEO, or similar.

What Success Looks Like

title: Direct Response Video Ads Editor
description:

Our marketing strategy relies heavily on compelling video ads designed to convert viewers into buyers. We need someone who understands the psychology of direct response advertising and has the technical skills to produce high-quality, engaging video content that drives results.



You will be working with our marketing team to create impactful video ads using pre-provided B-roll footage. Your ability to craft effective hooks, structure engaging narratives, and utilize AI tools to enhance creativity will be critical to your success. This role requires someone who can not only edit quickly but also deliver content that performs exceptionally well on platforms like Meta Ads.



We are particularly interested in candidates who are motivated to work exclusively with us and contribute to the long-term growth of our brand.



Key Responsibilities:



- Editing direct response video ads using tools such as CapCut, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or similar apps. Preferably (but not necessary) using only CapCut so that the rest of the team can make small edits if necessary.



- Crafting high-converting video ads with three hooks per video to maximize engagement.



- Utilizing AI tools like ElevenLabs and AI Personas to enhance creativity and delivery.



- Testing all videos on Meta Ads to evaluate performance and refine creative approaches.



- Collaborating with our marketing team to ensure video content aligns with brand messaging and marketing goals.



- Continuously optimizing editing techniques to improve ad performance.



Qualifications & Skills:



- Proven experience editing direct response ads for e-commerce brands.



- Proficiency in CapCut, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or similar editing software.



- Familiarity with AI tools like ElevenLabs and AI Personas.



- Strong understanding of direct response advertising principles.



- Ability to work quickly and deliver high-quality content under tight deadlines.



- Effective communication skills and the ability to collaborate within a team.



- Motivation to work exclusively for our brand and contribute to its growth.



- We're selling to the Scandinavian countries, as well as USA and UK. So it's important you're familiary with how video ads look and feel in those markets. Think TikTok and Instagram.





Application Process:



- To ensure you have read this listing carefully, please begin your application with the phrase: “I create high-converting video ads.”



In your application, please include the following:



- A brief description of your experience with video editing and direct response ads.



- Links to previous work, especially relevant e-commerce ads.



- Your availability and how quickly you can start.



- Why you are interested in working with our brand specifically.



This is a remote position with flexible hours, and compensation will be determined based on your experience and skill level. We are excited to find a talented individual who is eager to grow with us and consistently deliver outstanding results.



Apply now to join our team and help us take our advertising efforts to the next level.

title: Chief Operating Officer (COO)
description:
Chief Operating Officer (COO)



About Us



We are a fast-growing jewelry brand for women, serving customers across the US and Europe. We are a lean, performance-driven team that moves fast, holds high standards, and genuinely enjoys working together. As we scale, we are looking for an experienced Chief Operating Officer who can own both the backend operations and support the frontend growth side of the business.



What You Step Into



You are not starting from scratch. We have built a solid foundation for you to work from and improve on:



A fully integrated internal software system that covers all key operational areas, with existing SOPs already in place that you are encouraged to refine and improve over time

Internal sheets and dashboards that give you a clear, real-time view of performance across all departments

Direct access to the founders and other department heads, with short communication lines and fast decision-making

A motivated, high-quality team that is genuinely invested in doing good work

A structured environment where processes exist, but there is still room to make your mark



The Role



This is a senior, fully remote, full-time position. As COO, you are the operational backbone of the company. You manage the entire backend, keep the team aligned, and work closely with the founders on both operations and growth. You are not just an executor. You think strategically, report clearly, and take ownership of outcomes.

title: Google Ads Specialist (Lead Generation & E-Commerce)

We already have successful Google Ads systems running across multiple client accounts. We are looking for someone who can understand what is already working, identify opportunities for improvement, and help us expand our capabilities across the Google advertising ecosystem.



You will initially work across a small number of accounts and be responsible for auditing campaigns, identifying opportunities, making recommendations, and implementing optimizations.



As the role grows, you may become responsible for additional accounts and helping us develop new Google Ads offerings.

* Experience with Google Tag Manager (GTM)

* Experience with Google Analytics 4 (GA4)

* Experience working with service-based businesses

* Audit existing campaigns and identify opportunities

* Understand our current acquisition systems

* Improve campaign performance through testing and optimization

* Recommend new strategies and channels where appropriate

* Improve tracking and attribution accuracy

* Identify opportunities within Search, Display, YouTube, Remarketing and Performance Max

* Audit landing pages and conversion paths

* Think strategically rather than simply making changes inside an ad account

* Present recommendations clearly and logically



---



## Initial Project



As part of the hiring process, shortlisted candidates will be asked to review one of our existing Google Ads accounts and provide:



### 1. Current Strategy Assessment



What do you believe the current acquisition strategy is?



### 2. What's Working?

### 3. Opportunities For Improvement

* YouTube

* Performance Max

* Remarketing

* Other opportunities you identify

This exercise is designed to identify strategic thinkers who can understand an existing system before proposing changes.



---

* Your strategy

* Key optimizations

* Results achieved

* Lessons learned



---

**GOOGLE GROWTH SPECIALIST**

title: Community Growth & Partnerships Lead WFH
description:

---



The Mission (Why This Role Exists)



We are Personify, an AI platform helping creators and agencies scale their influence. We have a great product and 500 active users, but our biggest growth bottlenecks are discoverability and organic trust.



We don't just need a "community manager." We need a growth architect who will use Reddit, SEO, and AI-driven search strategies (GEO) to put Personify in front of the right people. In 6 months, your primary KPIs are: Grow our organic web traffic by 300% and establish Personify as the #1 discussed AI tool in our niche subreddits.



---



Who We Are Looking For (The Non-Negotiables)



We don't have time to teach the fundamentals. You must clearly demonstrate these in your application:



1. Reddit Growth Expert: You understand Reddit deeply. You know how to build subreddit presence, engage authentically, run AMAs, and drive quality traffic without getting banned for spam. You can show examples of posts that went viral or drove measurable sign-ups.

2. SEO & Content Strategist: You have hands-on experience with on-page SEO, keyword research (Ahrefs/SEMrush), and link-building strategies that actually move the needle.

3. AI SEO / GEO Specialist: You understand how Generative Engine Optimization works. You know how to structure content (FAQs, Q&A, conversational language, schema markup) so that AI models (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini) surface Personify as the authoritative answer.

4. Exceptional Writer: You can write persuasive, human-sounding content that ranks well and engages real people on forums.



---



What You Will Own (Outcomes, Not Just Tasks)



· Reddit & Forum Dominance: Develop and execute a seeding strategy across 5-10 relevant subreddits. Engage daily, identify trending conversations, and position Personify as the go-to solution without being salesy.

· SEO & GEO Strategy: Own our content calendar. Optimize existing blog posts for AI search, target high-intent long-tail keywords, and build topical authority clusters that rank on Google and in AI answer engines.

· Partnerships for Backlinks: Build relationships with creators, agencies, and SaaS founders—not for sales calls, but for high-authority backlinks, guest posts, and co-marketing content that boosts our Domain Authority.

· Customer Advocacy to Content: Turn our power users into case studies, testimonials, and Reddit success stories that fuel our organic growth flywheel.



---



You Won’t Enjoy This Role If... (Honest Expectation Setting)



· You expect immediate viral results overnight. SEO and GEO take 3-6 months to compound—you must be patient and data-driven.

· You are uncomfortable engaging in public forums and handling critical comments with grace.

· You need a fully built-out content playbook (we are a startup—you will build this from scratch with the founder).

· You prefer passive marketing; this role requires daily, proactive community seeding and content publishing.



---



Why Join Us? (The High-Performer Deal)



· Direct Mentorship: Work directly with the Founder/CEO. Your ideas go straight into the product strategy and content roadmap.

· Massive Career Leap: This starts hourly, but we treat it as a try-out for leadership. Perform well, and we transition you into a senior Growth/SEO role with equity as we scale.

· Cutting-Edge Skills: You'll be on the front lines of GEO—a skill that is currently in massive demand as AI search reshapes the internet.

· Flexibility: 100% remote with an async-first culture.



---



Bonus Skills (Nice-to-Have, Not Required)



· LinkedIn Sales Navigator experience (for partnership backlink outreach).

· Experience with Affiliate/Referral program management.

· Basic graphic design or video editing for Reddit content.



---



???? HOW TO APPLY (READ THIS CAREFULLY - NON-NEGOTIABLE)



We receive hundreds of generic applications. To prove you read this and are serious, do not just click "Send Application."



Instead, send me a direct message through OnlineJobs.ph with this exact subject line:

"Growth Lead – [Your Full Name]"



In the body of your message, paste a link to a 1-page PDF (or Google Doc) answering these 3 exact questions:



1. Reddit Strategy: Name 3 specific subreddits where our target audience (AI creators, founders, or agencies) hangs out. How would you engage them in Month 1 without getting banned?

2. GEO Expertise: Give us one example of a blog post topic we should write, and explain how you would optimize it specifically for AI search engines (ChatGPT/Perplexity) differently than you would for Google.

3. Keyword Opportunity: Share 3 high-intent, low-competition keywords you would target to drive organic sign-ups, and tell us why you chose them.



Applications without this PDF link and the correct subject line will be deleted without a reply.



Shortlisted candidates will be invited to a 30-minute paid trial call where we will audit your Reddit strategy live. We are looking for a long-term partner—let's grow together.

title: Sales & Account Growth Specialist — Turn Buyers Into Loyal, Growing Accounts (Peptides / Human Performance)
description:
Mindtek supplies research-use peptides and human-performance products to a knowledgeable, high-intent customer base. This role isn't about taking orders — it's about growing them: understanding what each customer is really trying to achieve, matching the right products, and nurturing that relationship so they come back, buy more, and stay.



You do not need years in our exact niche. You need to be a real salesperson — curious, quick to learn, and genuinely good at building trust and expanding accounts. We'll teach you the products and the science. What we can't teach is instinct for the sale and care for the customer.



This role is probably right for you if you've done work like:



Consultative or account-based sales (B2B or premium B2C)

Retention, customer success, or account management with an upsell/cross-sell target

Supplements, wellness, fitness, biohacking, med-device, or pharma sales

Financial advising, insurance, SaaS, or any role where you grew accounts over time

Any role where you turned a one-time buyer into a repeat, higher-value customer



What you'll actually do (the specialized skills we're hiring for)



Consultative selling: diagnose what the customer is trying to achieve, then recommend the right product — not the most expensive one

Cross-selling: spot complementary products and stacks that genuinely fit the customer's goals

Upselling: move customers to higher tiers, bundles, or subscriptions when it's the right call for them

Nurturing & LTV: run disciplined follow-up, re-engage dormant customers, and build relationships that compound over months, not one transaction

Keep a clean pipeline in our CRM and report your own numbers weekly (we value people who self-monitor)

Learn our product line and the underlying science fast — and keep learning



Non-negotiables



Excellent written and spoken English; a warm, sharp, trustworthy presence on chat,
, and calls

Proven ability to sell and grow accounts — you can point to numbers or specific wins

Genuine curiosity about performance, longevity, and the science — and proof you learn complex things fast on your own

Strict compliance: our products are research-use / performance — you sell within that framing and never make medical, therapeutic, or dosing claims. Integrity over any single sale.

Reliable quiet home office, stable internet, comfort with CRMs and tech (or obviously able to pick them up fast)



What we don't want



Pushy, spammy, "spray-and-pray" selling. Fake urgency. Over-promising. We grow accounts by being genuinely useful.



Schedule & setup: Full-time, fully remote. [Confirm hours — suggest Mon–Fri core hours with flexibility for customer time zones.]



Compensation: Competitive fixed base + strong performance commission (rewarding growth, repeat business, and account expansion), discussed at interview.



Growth: Long-term seat. Top performers grow into senior/account-lead and team roles as we expand across the region.

title: Student Operations Assistant — Remote (Australian Education Company)
description:
About us

Lee Mathematics Tuition is a fast-growing online maths tutoring company based in Sydney, Australia, serving 200+ families across the country. We match students with expert tutors and support them through their whole learning journey. Our small, tight operations team keeps everything running — and we are growing fast, so we need another reliable set of hands.



About the role

You will be the operational right hand to our Student Success Coordinator — the person who keeps the day-to-day running while a dozen things happen at once. This is a role for someone who is organized to their core and calm under pressure: you will be coordinating tutors and parents, processing lesson reschedules, running new-student onboarding, and keeping every record accurate — all while the phone rings. A lot of the repetitive admin is being automated, so your real value is the human judgment a system cannot do: staying on top of many moving parts, talking to parents warmly, and never dropping a ball when three things land at once.



What you will do

Keep the day's moving parts organized and on track — nothing dropped, even when several things land at once

Handle lesson reschedule requests end to end — take them in, update the schedule, and confirm with both the parent and the tutor

Run our new-student onboarding checklist from start to finish (records, tutor matching, first lessons)

Answer and return parent calls and messages promptly and warmly (phone, SMS,
)

Send welcome messages, first-lesson check-ins, and invoice reminders (templated)

Keep our task boards and systems accurate and up to date so nothing slips



Who you are

Exceptionally organized — you juggle many tasks at once, prioritize fast, and stay calm and methodical when it is busy (this is the heart of the role)

Warm, clear, confident English on the phone with Australian parents — you are the voice they hear (equally essential)

Reliable and proactive — you follow things through and keep your own systems tidy without being chased

Comfortable learning new software quickly (we use TutorBird, Notion, Asana, Aircall, Stripe and HubSpot)

Available during Australian Eastern business hours (see below)



Nice to have

Experience in an operations, admin, coordination, or virtual assistant role

Experience speaking with English-speaking (ideally Australian) customers by phone



Details

Full-time, remote (work from home)

Hours: Monday–Friday 8:00 AM–4:30 PM PHT + Saturday 7:30 AM–10:00 AM PHT (~45 hrs/week) — aligned to Australian Eastern business hours

?30,000–40,000/month depending on experience, reviewed after a 1-month probation

Long-term role with genuine room to grow as the company scales



How to apply

Start your application with the word SYDNEY so we know you read this properly. Then include a 1–2 minute voice recording (record on your phone and share a link — e.g. Vocaroo or Google Drive) covering: (1) a quick intro about yourself, and (2) this scenario — "It is Monday morning and three things land at once: one parent wants to reschedule tomorrow's lesson, another is upset their tutor was late, and you have got two new students to set up. Walk us through how you would handle it and what you would do first." We want to hear both how you sound on the phone and how you think through a busy morning.

title: Patient Advisor — We'll Teach You the Science. You Bring the Ability to Change Minds.
description:
The short version We help high-performing adults optimise energy, recovery, and longevity through medically supervised protocols. You'll be the person our patients talk to — guiding thoughtful, often skeptical, high-net-worth people from "curious" to "committed" without a single pushy word.



You do not need a medical degree or years of "closing." You need to be genuinely curious, quick to learn, emotionally intelligent, and unusually good at earning trust in conversation. We will train you deeply on the science and the protocols. What we cannot train is how you make people feel understood.



This role is probably right for you if you've done work like:



Nursing, med-tech, pharmacy, allied health, or any clinical/patient-facing role

Premium hospitality, concierge, luxury retail, or private client service

Financial advising, insurance, real estate, or other consultative (not transactional) sales

Recruitment, coaching, therapy, or customer-success/retention

Anything where you had to build real trust fast and guide a smart person to a good decision



If you can point to a time you changed someone's mind by asking better questions — not by pressuring them — keep reading.



What you'll actually do



Be the first human our patients speak with; understand their goals and concerns before recommending anything

Run structured discovery conversations (we give you the framework) and guide people to the right protocol — or honestly tell them when it isn't for them

Follow up with care and precision so no one falls through the cracks

Keep clean records and report your own numbers weekly (we value people who self-monitor)

Learn our products, the science, and the protocols fast — and keep learning



Non-negotiables



Excellent written and spoken English; a warm, clear, grounded phone/video presence

High EQ and comfort with high-net-worth, well-informed, sometimes skeptical people

A genuine curiosity about health, longevity, and human performance — and proof you learn complex things quickly on your own

Reliable, quiet home office, stable internet, and the discipline to work a fixed remote schedule

Comfortable with technology and CRMs (or obviously able to pick them up fast)



What we don't want



Pressure tactics, "guru" scripts, fake urgency, or over-promising. Patient outcomes come before any sale, always.



Schedule & setup: Full-time, fully remote. Mon–Fri 9:00–17:00, plus flexible Saturday follow-ups (10:00–15:00).



Compensation: Competitive fixed monthly base + performance commission, discussed at interview.



Growth: This is a long-term seat. Top performers grow into senior advisory and team-lead roles as we expand across the region.

mbers and follow up until required actions are completed.

title: Real Estate Transaction Coordinator / Title Closing Specialist - (U.S.-based experience required)

• Manage U.S. real estate transactions from contract negotiation through closing, maintaining ownership of all requirements and outstanding items.

• Maintain complete transaction files and provide clear status reports identifying risks, pending items, responsible parties, and next actions.

• Proactively follow up with all parties and drive each transaction toward closing.

Qualifications:

• Minimum 10+ years of overall real estate experience with at least 3 to 4 years of direct experience handling U.S. real estate transactions.

• Proven experience closing U.S. real estate transactions and coordinating the full closing process.

• Mandatory hands-on experience with foreclosures and distressed-property transactions. Experience limited to routine residential transactions is not sufficient.

• Experience with bankruptcy-related transactions, short sales, title defects, liens, judgments, or other complicated closing matters.

• Experience supporting contract negotiation and transaction execution.

• Strong understanding of U.S. title, closing, and real estate transaction procedures.

• Excellent written and spoken English, strong organization, attention to detail, judgment, and follow-through.

• Ability to manage multiple active transactions and deadlines independently in a fast-paced environment.

• Ability to work remotely and coordinate effectively with a U.S.-based team with sufficient overlap with the U.S. Eastern Time Zone.



Preferred Qualifications:

• Prior experience as a real estate transaction coordinator, title closer, title-company closing specialist, foreclosure transaction specialist, distressed-property coordinator, short-sale specialist, real estate paralegal, or investor-side acquisitions/dispositions coordinator.

• Experience working for a U.S. title company, real estate law firm, foreclosure or bankruptcy law firm, real estate investment company, distressed-property investor, mortgage servicer, lender, escrow company, or settlement company.

• Experience with New York real estate transactions is strongly preferred, although substantial experience in other U.S. jurisdictions will be considered.

• Legal education or paralegal experience is an advantage; however, practical transaction execution and closing experience are the primary requirements.

• Demonstrated ability to identify, track, escalate, and help resolve issues that could prevent a transaction from closing.



Work Arrangement:

• Work from home / fully remote.

• Sufficient working-hour overlap with the U.S. Eastern Time Zone is required.

• Reliable computer, stable internet connection, and professional remote working environment are required

title: Elite Video Editor + Social Media Growth Manager
description:

title: High-Commission Real Estate ISA / Cold Caller (20 Hours/Week)
description:
We are looking for a sharp, highly articulate Inside Sales Agent (ISA) to handle 20 hours per week of outbound phone prospecting. You will be calling property owners, pre-qualifying leads, and transferring warm prospects to our agents. 



Your goal is NOT to sell or close over the phone; You are simply identifying open, friendly owners who are interested in receiving a private market evaluation.



Schedule & Hours:

* 20 Hours per Week (4 hours/day, 1PM-5PM Monday–Friday, US PST business hours).



Compensation:

* Base Pay: $4.50 – $5.50/hr (paid weekly/bi-weekly).

* BIG PERFORMANCE BONUS: $1,000 USD bonus for EVERY lead you generate that results in a closed transaction. 



Key Responsibilities:

* Execute 300+ system dials/day using a multi-line dialer (Mojo).

* Filter out wrong numbers, hangups, and uninterested contacts.

* Pre-qualify open sellers based on timeline, equity, and motivation.

* Pass warm, pre-qualified leads to our agents.



Requirements:

* Minimum 1–2 years of experience as a US Real Estate ISA / Cold Caller.

* Outstanding, fluent spoken English with a neutral accent and warm phone presence.

* Experience operating multi-line dialers (Mojo).

* High-speed internet, noise-canceling headset, and quiet workspace.



How to Apply:

1. Submit your resume detailing your real estate cold-calling history.

2. REQUIRED: Include a link to a 30-second audio sample (Vocaroo/Google Drive) introducing yourself and giving a brief overview of your ISA experience. 

(Applications without a voice sample will be automatically ignored.)

description:
We are a fast-growing talent management company working with creators, helping them grow .We're looking for someone sharp, organized, and creative to grow with our team.



The Role

We're hiring an Executive Assistant to work directly with one of our Executive Talent Managers. You'll be his right hand, keeping him organized and taking work off his plate across communication, design, scheduling, and recruiting.



What You'll Do

- Manage his inbox, calendar, and meeting scheduling

- Communicate directly with his creators in a friendly, clear, professional way (not reliant on AI)

- Design flyers, graphics, and social assets (mainly in Canva)

- Source and screen creator leads and support recruiting outreach

- Track tasks and follow-ups, keeping projects moving without needing to be chased

- Jump in on day-to-day admin and operations work as needed



Who We're Looking For

- 1-2+ years as a VA, EA, or admin support (bonus: social media, influencer, or agency experience)

- Strong graphic design skills and fluent in Canva

- Excellent written English and a warm communication style

- Highly organized, proactive, detail-oriented, and self-managing

- Comfortable at a fast pace with quick turnarounds

- Reliable internet and able to commit to around 90 hours/month with some overlap with US hours



The Details
