title: Amazon Operations and Team Manager| 3+ Years Experience
description:
Who We Are

BTS Brands is an 8-year-old private label company selling across US, CA, UK, EU, AU, JP and expanding into Saudi Arabia. We operate across two brands: one in travel accessories and one in beauty devices, with 52+ active SKUs. We're at a turning point: moving from a founder-run business to a properly managed, systems-run company. This role is central to that transition.



The Role

This is not a VA role. This is an operations and team management position for someone who has done this before in an ecommerce or Amazon environment.



You will report directly to the two Founders and manage a team of 8-9 people across our Creative and Operations teams. You'll take our existing processes - currently scattered and undocumented - and build a proper system in ClickUp from scratch. You'll create SOPs, track KPIs, run tea
etings, and make sure everyone knows what they're doing and when.



Your mission is to build the systems, rhythm, and accountability that let the company run smoothly, without the founders being involved in every daily decision.



If you need someone to tell you what to do every day, this isn't the right fit. If you thrive with clear objectives and the autonomy to build real systems - and you're just as comfortable doing the daily operational grind as you are building the systems - keep reading.



What You'll Do:

-Set up ClickUp from scratch across all departments: workflows, dashboards, automations, task structures

-Make sure all work is captured in the system - nothing managed informally or lost in chat

-Be the team's first point of contact for day-to-day questions and blockers - not the founders

-Chase deadlines directly with tea
mbers and follow up when tasks haven't been updated

-Coordinate between Creative and Operations teams so projects move smoothly, resolving small cross-department friction points without escalating

-Document existing business processes into clear, usable SOPs

-Handle day-to-day approvals within defined boundaries, escalating only real issues to the founders

-Lead weekly/monthly KPI reviews and quarterly planning sessions

-Run the weekly tea
eting - status updates, blockers, decisions - focused and on time

-Translate founders' quarterly objectives into clear team and individual goals

-Monitor performance, spot problems early, and drive corrective action

-Track and report operational KPIs and cost trends, flagging profitability signals for the founders' review

-Build and manage the product-launch workflow based on the existing 15-step launch process

-Spot what's slowing the team down and fix it - don't just flag it

-Onboard new hires: set up tools, assign SOPs, guide their first weeks



Where the Founders Stay Involved

To be clear about where this role starts and stops: the Founders will continue to own overall company direction and priorities; brand, product, and market strategy; final decisions on launches, positioning, and pricing; approval of budgets, salaries, hiring/firing, and major investments; and review of high-level KPIs and reports.



This role owns everything else: the daily execution, systems, and team accountability that make those strategic decisions possible - including the follow-up, reminders, and day-to-day problem-solving that used to fall on the founders.



Tools You Must Know:

-ClickUp - expert level, you've built systems from scratch before

-Google Sheets / Excel - KPI dashboards, reporting

-Slack or similar - team communication

-Amazon Seller Central - you don't need to be a specialist, but you need to understand the context

-Zoom - weekly meetings with owner and team



Who We're Looking For:

We're looking for someone who's been in the trenches of ecommerce operations - not someone who's managed tasks, but someone who's built systems and led people.



-3+ years in operations or team management in an ecommerce or Amazon environment

-You've built SOPs from scratch and know how to make processes that people actually follow

-You've set up ClickUp or similar tools for a team starting from zero

-You know how to keep a remote team aligned and accountable - without being on their back every hour

-You're comfortable with numbers - KPIs, margins, performance tracking

-You're energized by the operational grind, not just the systems and dashboards, because that's most of what this role actually is day to day

-Excellent English, written and verbal

-Familiarity with Amazon tools

-You're looking for somewhere to grow long-term, not just another contract



Compensation & Setup:

-$1,800-$2,000/month based on experience

-Full-time, 40h/week

-14 days paid leave after 3 months

-First 3 months: time-tracked via Time Doctor as part of our standard onboarding process

-Long-term position - We Invest in People Who Invest in Us



What Success Looks Like

-Within 1 month: ClickUp is fully adopted, the weekly rhythm is running, and the founders' approval load has dropped significantly

-Within 3 months: KPIs are tracked and reviewed consistently; the team works to clear quarterly goals

-Within 6 months: the company runs smoothly day-to-day without the founders being involved in every decision



To Apply - Required

Answer these 4 questions. 



1. Describe a project management system you built from scratch (ClickUp, Asana, Monday, or similar) - what was the situation, how did you structure it, and what changed after? Only apply if you have actually done this. Do not describe what you would do - describe what you did.

2. How do you hold a remote team accountable without micromanaging? Give a real example from one of the companies listed in your CV: include the team size, what tool you used, and what happened when someone missed a deadline. Do not describe what you would do - describe what you actually did.

3. Walk me through a company from your CV where you managed people — how many reported directly to you, what were their roles, and what did your  one-on-ones or check-ins with them actually look like? What's one decision about a tea
mber (raise, warning, letting someone go, promotion) that was yours to make?

4. What project management tools have you used, and rate your confidence in each from 1 to 10. For the tool you rated highest - what's one thing you can do in it that most people don't know about?





Please also include your salary expectation and availability.

title: Full-Stack Developer, Website Support, and SEO
description:
Position Overview



We are seeking an experienced and trustworthy Full-Stack Developer to take over an existing business dashboard and ensure that all technical assets are fully owned, controlled, and documented under our company accounts.



The current system uses Vercel, Prisma, GitHub, and a small database. The selected developer will review the existing setup, transfer or reconnect all services to company-owned accounts, verify that the system is functioning correctly, and provide complete documentation and administrative access.



This role may also include ongoing website development, maintenance, performance improvements, and search engine optimization.



Project Objectives



The primary objective is to ensure that our company has full ownership and custody of:



* GitHub repositories and source code

* Vercel projects, deployments, domains, and environment variables

* Prisma database projects, credentials, and connection settings

* Database data, backups, schemas, and migration history

* Website hosting and domain-related configurations

* Third-party services, integrations, and API credentials

* Technical documentation and administrative access



All accounts and services must be registered using company-controlled
 addresses. Personal
 addresses, temporary Gmail accounts, personal phone numbers, or developer-owned accounts must not be used unless we provide written approval.



Responsibilities



The selected developer will:



1. Audit the existing dashboard, website, database, hosting, repositories, integrations, and account access.

2. Confirm the current ownership and administrator status of all GitHub, Vercel, Prisma, domain, database, analytics, and related accounts.

3. Transfer or recreate all services under company-owned accounts when necessary.

4. Migrate the GitHub repository into a company-owned GitHub organization or account while preserving:

   - Source code

   - Branches

   - Commit history

   - Issues

   - Deployment workflows

   - Collaborator permissions

   - Webhooks and integrations



5. Transfer or recreate the Vercel project while preserving:

    - Production and preview deployments

   - Custom domains

   - Environment variables

   - Build settings

   - Deployment settings

   - GitHub integration

   - Team permissions



6. Transfer or reconnect the Prisma database and verify:



   - Database availability

   - Schema integrity

   - Connection strings

   - Environment variables

   - Migration history

   - User permissions

   - Backup and recovery procedures



7. Test the complete application after migration to confirm that all dashboard features, website pages, forms, integrations, and database functions continue working correctly.

8. Remove unauthorized or unnecessary access after the transition is complete.

9. Provide secure administrative access to designated company representatives.

10. Create clear technical documentation covering:

- System architecture

- Hosting setup

- Repository structure

- Database configuration

- Deployment process

- Environment variables

- Backup procedures

- Account ownership

- User permissions

- Troubleshooting and recovery procedures

11. Assist with ongoing website updates, bug fixes, feature development, and technical maintenance.

12. Perform search engine optimization work, including:

- Technical SEO audit

- Page speed improvements

- Metadata optimization

- Heading and content structure

- Image optimization

- Sitemap and robots.txt review

- Google Search Console setup or review

- Analytics configuration

- Indexing issue resolution

- Mobile performance improvements

- Structured data recommendations



 Required Qualifications



* Proven experience with GitHub repository transfers and organization management

* Strong experience with Vercel project deployment and account migration

* Experience with Prisma ORM and Prisma-managed database environments

* Strong understanding of database backups, schemas, migrations, and access control

* Experience with modern web application development

* Ability to troubleshoot deployment and environment variable issues

* Knowledge of website security and administrator access management

* Experience with technical SEO and website performance optimization

* Ability to document systems clearly for nontechnical business owners

* Strong communication, professionalism, and transparency



Ownership and Security Requirements



The developer must agree that:

* All source code, databases, configurations, documentation, credentials, and project assets created or managed during the engagement belong exclusively to our company.

* All production accounts must be created under company-controlled
 addresses.

* The developer may not retain exclusive ownership or administrative control over any company system.

* The developer may not use personal accounts as the permanent owner of company assets.

* All credentials and access information must be provided to the company.

* The developer must disclose all third-party services and integrations used by the system.

* No company data or source code may be copied, retained, reused, or shared without written authorization.

* Access must be removed promptly when the engagement ends or when requested by the company.

* Any subcontractors must be disclosed and approved in advance.



Initial Deliverables

The initial engagement should include:

1. Complete technical audit

2. Written migration and ownership plan

3. Transfer of GitHub, Vercel, and Prisma assets

4. Verification of company administrator access

5. Database backup and recovery confirmation

6. Production testing after migration

7. Removal of unnecessary prior access

8. Complete system documentation

9. List of all recurring platform costs

10. Recommendations for website development and SEO

11. Estimated hours for ongoing support



Applicants should not provide a general estimate without first explaining the tasks included, expected hours, risks, and deliverables.



Preferred Engagement Structure



This may begin as a fixed-price migration and technical audit project. After successful completion, the developer may be considered for ongoing website development, dashboard improvements, maintenance, and SEO work.



Trust, transparency, complete company ownership, proper documentation, and reliable communication are essential requirements for this role.

title: Appointment Setter / SDR
description:
We’re a B2B outbound agency looking for a full-time SDR whose sole focus is keeping our funnel topped up. This is a pure outbound role — no account management, no fulfillment, nothing but pipeline generation.



Priority #1 — Handle interested leads. We run cold
 at scale (~1,500 sends/day), and interested replies come in daily. Your top priority is engaging those interested leads and booking calls. You’ll work out of our portal’s custom inbox, which makes replying fast and easy. For each interested lead, the expected cadence is:



: up to 4 follow-ups

Phone: 7 calls total (when we’re able to source a number)

LinkedIn: max 3 touchpoints, sent on behalf of one of our accounts



Priority #2 — Cold outbound. Once all interested leads are worked, you move to cold outreach from lists we provide. This means phone dialing and LinkedIn messaging only — we handle cold
 at scale, so that’s not part of your job.



Nice to have — Discovery calls. If you have prior client-facing experience or have run sales calls before, we’re open to letting you handle discovery calls (qualifying leads to see whether they fit our criteria). We’ll coach you on how we do this. No experience here? That’s fine — it’s a bonus, not a requirement.



Growth path. This role has a clear path forward: perform well and we’ll promote you to Account Executive, where you’ll close deals and earn more.



Requirements:



Near-perfect spoken English (this is non-negotiable — you’ll be on the phone with US prospects)

Able to work EST hours (our leads span EST/PST/MST)



Prior SDR / appointment-setting experience — please share examples of outbound work you’ve done before (results, tools, campaigns)



Available to start ASAP



To apply: Send a short intro, your relevant experience, and any proof of past outbound results.

title: Graphic Designer – Book Design & Author Branding
description:
Job Description: Graphic Designer – Book Design & Author Branding



Location: Remote (WFH)

Type: Part-Time Freelance (Project-Based, Hourly)

Confidentiality: High (Non-Disclosure Agreement Required)



Role Overview

We're building a talent pool of Graphic Designers who specialize in book interior design and layout. You'll design book covers, interior layouts, and possibly full author branding packages. This is a project-based role paid on an hourly basis starting at roughly one book a month, with volume increasing as needed. Due to the sensitive nature of the work, a signed NDA is mandatory, and use of AI tools on client materials is prohibited under a signed addendum.



Key Responsibilities

Book Cover Design: Design and present 3 cover concepts per title within 1 week of receiving the brief; revise until the client is satisfied.



Book Interior Layout: Design and format book interiors in InDesign using character styles and paragraph styles.



Proof Rounds: Before proceeding to full interior design, deliver proofs of key page designs for client approval — title page, table of contents, a chapter title page, and a text spread including a pullout quote.



Turnaround: Full book layout completed within 2 weeks of brief/content handoff.



Revisions: Incorporate client feedback and handle revision rounds efficiently.



File Management: Deliver print-ready and organized files via Dropbox.





Compensation & Work Structure

Rate: $5–7/hour

Volume: Starting at 1 book/month, with potential to scale up

Project-Based: Talent pool model. Engagement occurs on a per-project basis

Flexible Remote Work: Work from your own space while coordinating with an international team.



Required Skills & Qualifications

InDesign Expert: High-level proficiency — character styles, paragraph styles, master pages, and long-document formatting are non-negotiable.



Book Design Portfolio: Strong portfolio demonstrating book cover and interior layout work.



Branding Experience: Proven experience designing branding and marketing collateral.



Print Knowledge: Familiarity with print-ready file prep including bleeds, margins, and color profiles.



Remote Setup: Access to a high-performance computer and reliable internet.



Discretion: Total commitment to maintaining confidentiality and protecting client data.



No AI Tools: Client work must be produced without AI-assisted design, image generation, or content tools.



Nice To Have but not required

Author Branding: Build out branding packages including logos, business cards, brochures, posters, banners, and social media templates.



Social Media Graphics: Design static posts and graphics for author promotion across platforms.



Website design experience using Figma



Experience designing for self-published or indie authors



How to Apply:

Submit your application here: 



(DM's WILL NOT BE ENTERTAINED)



IF YOU DO NOT MEET ALL THE REQUIREMENTS, PLEASE DO NOT APPLY.



Note: Shortlisted candidates must sign an NDA before any project details are shared.

title: Real Estate AI Image-to-Video Creator Needed

- Proven experience creating AI image-to-video content for real estate listings specifically (mandatory)

- Experience with AI virtual staging tools

- An eye for cinematic style, pacing, and real estate aesthetics

- Reliable, communicative, and able to meet deadlines

- Good English communication



Portfolio is mandatory. Your portfolio must include real estate property videos made with AI image-to-video tools. Applications without a real estate AI video portfolio will not be considered.

Before any full-time commitment, we start with a paid test project ($10) where you will create a short property video from photos we provide. This lets us evaluate your workflow and output quality before moving forward.



Compensation: $700-$1,000/month (full time), based on experience and portfolio quality.

title: Senior Content Strategist
description:
She's Making Millions is a fast-growing brand and movement helping ambitious women scale their businesses, elevate their influence, and build wealth with purpose. We run world-class events (including SMM Live, our flagship conference in November 2026), The Boardroom (our strategic advisory experience), and The She's Making Millions Podcast. Our audience is sharp, ambitious, and pays attention. Our content has to be sharper.



The Role in One Line

You own the content strategy and the creative direction. You come up with the ideas that go viral, you d
 what we make, and you hand the brief to the execution team. You do not produce or schedule. You think, direct, and grow.



Why We're Hiring

We have a strong execution team, a brand voice that lands, and a high-intent audience. What we don't have is a world-class strategic mind owning content. We need someone who can take this brand from "good content" to "the content women in business save, share, and quote". Specifically, we need someone who can deliver the audience and ticket sales for SMM Live in November 2026.



Primary Focus Areas



1. Own the rolling 90-day content strategy across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and
..

2. Concept and direct viral content (reels, shorts, hook-driven posts) that grows our following and engagement..

3. Lead the content side of the SMM Live campaign: build the strategy that fills the room..

4. Direct the marketing team on what to make, when, and why..

5. Track what's working, iterate fast, kill what isn't..



Key Responsibilities



Strategy

• Build and own a rolling 90-day content strategy with clear monthly themes and weekly content pillars..

• Set the growth targets per platform and the strategy to hit them..

• D
 what content series we run, what we kill, and when to pivot..

• Lead the content strategy for SMM Live (Nov 2026), Yacht Party, Scaling Secrets, and Boardroom enrolment campaigns..



Creative Direction

• Concept viral-worthy content ideas weekly: hooks, formats, angles, talking points..

• Brief the video editor on what to film, how to cut, and what to lead with..

• Brief designers on visual direction for carousels and graphics..

• Brief the marketing assistant on what needs to be scheduled, posted, and how..

• Stay relentlessly on top of platform trends, viral formats, and audience behaviour..



Performance & Iteration

• Analyse content performance weekly: what's working, what's not, why..

• Iterate the strategy in real time based on data..

• Report monthly to the founder with metrics, insights, and the next 30-day plan..



Event Promotion

• Build the multi-month content runway for SMM Live and other major events..

• Concept the campaign hooks, sequencing, and content drops that drive ticket sales..

• Coordinate with the ads manager so paid and organic work as one campaign, not two..



What Success Looks Like (first 90 days)

• A documented 90-day content strategy delivered in your first two weeks..

• At least 2 pieces of content that hit viral metrics (1M+ views, or top 1% reach for the brand) within the first 60 days..

• Measurable follower and engagement growth across at least two platforms..

• A confirmed content runway and creative plan for the SMM Live campaign..

• Clear weekly briefs handed to the execution team so nothing stalls..



Required Experience

• Proven track record growing social media accounts (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube) to 100K+ followers. Show us the accounts..

• Multiple viral videos (1M+ views) that you concepted or led, not just contributed to. Show us the videos..

• Deep understanding of short-form video strategy, hook writing, and current platform algorithms..

• Strong written communication and creative brief writing..

• Comfortable working in a fast-moving brand where direction shifts and you ship anyway..



Bonus Experience

• Promoting events, conferences, or live experiences and driving ticket sales through organic content..

• Working with personal brands or female-led business brands..

• Direct response and conversion-focused content (not just brand-build)..

• Podcast content strategy..



Ideal Candidate

You are someone who:



• Lives and breathes social media and watches trends like other people watch the news..

• Has strong opinions on what works and why, and can back them up with data and case studies..

• Is a strategist first, not a creator. You direct the work, you don't make it..

• Can take a personal brand and 10x it within a year..

• Wants to be measured on growth and conversion, not output..



How You'll Work With the Team

• Founder:Weekly strategy meeting. You bring the plan, she signs off and brings the voice..

• Marketing assistant:You hand her the brief. She executes. She does not change the strategy..

• Video editor and designers:You direct what they make..

• Ads manager:You align paid and organic so they reinforce each other..



Rate

To be discussed based on experience and proven track record.



How to Apply

Send the following:



1. A 1-page note on why you'd be great for this role..

2. Three accounts you've grown, with before/after metrics and what you did..

3. Three viral videos you concepted (links, view counts, and what made them work)..

4. Your monthly rate and what's included..

title: Part-Time French-Speaking Instagram VA
description:
About Us



Caribico is a registered nonprofit building a global network of university and regional chapters for Caribbean and diaspora youth, guided by one idea: One Caribbean, One Future. We're now expanding into French-speaking communities, and we're looking for a reliable, detail-oriented person with fluent written French to help bring new chapters to life on Instagram and connect with students who want to be part of the movement.



The Role



You'll work from a clear, step-by-step playbook we provide — no guesswork. One chapter at a time, you'll take a brand-new Instagram account from setup all the way to a live application campaign over roughly a 2–3 week cycle. Everything you post and send for these chapters is in French, so native or near-native written French is essential. Once a chapter attracts its first round of applicants, you hand the list to our team and move on to the next one. No face on camera, and no prior experience in our world required — if you follow instructions carefully and show up consistently, we'll teach you the rest.



What You'll Do (per chapter)



Set up the chapter's Instagram profile using our brand assets and French bio template

Find and follow the right students at the target university — we tell you exactly which groups and accounts to target

Engage genuinely in French: thoughtful comments, replies, and DMs (we give you templates to personalize — never copy-paste spam)

Publish a short set of posts from our French templates, including the application-drive post

Build a simple Google Form from our template

Reach out directly to promising prospects and invite them to apply

Track applicants in a shared sheet and pass the shortlist to our team

Keep accounts healthy: capped daily follows, natural pacing, all manual — no bots, no automation



What We're Looking For



Native or fluent written French — this one's non-negotiable

Reliable and consistent: a little every day, on schedule, for the full cycle

Comfortable using Instagram the normal way (not through automation tools)

Detail-oriented, and able to follow a written SOP exactly

Organized, with clean, accurate record-keeping

Bonus: solid English too, plus any interest in the Caribbean, community organizing, or nonprofit work



Hours & Commitment



Around 10 hours a week to start — part-time and ongoing. This is a long-term role: as we open more chapters, dependable people take on more of them, with real room to grow.



To Apply



Start your message with the word CARIBAEA, so we know you read all the way through.

In French, write 2–3 sentences on why you'd be reliable in this role (this doubles as a quick check of your written French).

Confirm you can keep up consistent daily Instagram activity across 2–3 week stretches.

Optional but helpful: link any social account or page you've managed.



Strong candidates will be invited to a short paid task to start, so we can see your work firsthand. Do it well, and you're on the team for ongoing work.

title: Merchandise Planner - Retail Apparel & Footwear (Womens Fashion)
description:
Location: Sydney, Australia (Remote)

Hours: Monday to Friday, 9:00am – 5:00pm

Remuneration: US$350 pw, paid each Friday



About the Role



We're looking for a commercially minded Merchandise Planner to join our Planning team. This is a fantastic opportunity for someone who enjoys turning data into action, working closely with Buying, Retail Operations and Logistics to maximise sales, margin and inventory productivity.



You'll play a key role in planning product assortments, forecasting demand, managing inventory investment, and ensuring the right product is in the right place at the right time.



Key Responsibilities



Merchandise Planning

- Develop and manage merchandise financial plans across sales, margin, stock and intake.

- Produce monthly forecasts and reforecasts, identifying risks and opportunities.

- Manage Open-to-Buy (OTB) to support business sales and inventory targets.

- Analyse performance at department, category and subcategory level.

- Recommend buying depth, assortment and product mix based on customer demand and commercial performance.



Inventory & In-Season Trading

- Monitor inventory productivity and optimise stock investment.

- Recommend actions to pull forward or defer intake based on trading.

- Drive size curve recommendations by brand, category and store.

- Plan and execute store distribution strategies.

- Identify opportunities to improve sell-through and reduce excess inventory.

- Manage replenishment, allocations and store transfers where required.



Product Lifecycle Management

- Maintain visibility of inventory throughout the product lifecycle.

- Monitor product performance from launch through markdown.

- Develop and execute markdown and promotional pricing strategies.

- Manage full-price and markdown stock consolidations.

- Identify underperforming products and recommend corrective actions.

- Ensure purchase orders are received accurately and managed through to completion.



Forecasting & Reporting

- Produce weekly and monthly trading reports.

- Present insights and recommendations to key stakeholders.

- Monitor core product forecasts and update plans regularly.

- Analyse store capacity and support inventory planning by location.



Collaboration

- Partner closely with Buying, Retail Operations, Logistics and Warehouse teams.

- Build strong relationships across the business.

- Contribute to process improvements and planning initiatives.

- Support new store openings through assortment planning.







About You



You'll be analytical, commercially curious and comfortable making decisions using data.



You'll ideally have:



- 2+ years' experience in Merchandise Planning within retail.

- Strong commercial acumen and understanding of retail financial metrics.

- Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.

- Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.

- Experience with merchandise planning systems (AP21, Oracle, SAP, JDA, Blue Yonder or similar is advantageous).

- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

- Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities.

- A proactive mindset with a continuous improvement approach.





What You'll Bring

- Strong understanding of sales, margin, inventory and forecasting.

- Ability to interpret data and translate it into commercial actions.

- High attention to detail.

- Confidence presenting recommendations to stakeholders.

- A collaborative, team-first approach.

- Self-motivation and the ability to work effectively in a remote environment.





What We Offer

- Fully remote role based in Sydney.

- Opportunity to work with an experienced Planning team.

- Exposure to a fast-paced retail environment.

- Ongoing development and career progression opportunities.

- Supportive, collaborative team culture.

title: Content & Marketing Ops Executive
description:
FULL-TIME, REMOTE-BASED, WORK FROM HOME



Interested candidates, please submit your resume to Privacy Ninja at 
 look forward to welcoming a new member to our team!



Important Notes for Applicants

-> This is a full-time remote position. While the role is remote, the successful candidate is expected to work within Privacy Ninja’s standard working hours of 10:00 AM to 7:00 PM (Singapore Time).

-> Please apply only if you are able to commit to these working hours and the full-time nature of the role.

-> This position includes a 3-month probationary period. A separate probationary remuneration package will apply during this period.

-> All applications will go through an initial screening stage before interviews are scheduled. Candidates who are shortlisted for the interview stage are expected to come prepared to discuss their experience, and relevant past work, among others.

____________________________

ROLE PURPOSE:



The Content & Marketing Operations Executive is responsible for owning the day-to-day execution and operational quality of Privacy Ninja's marketing ecosystem.



This role ensures that websites, newsletters, social media, videos and marketing assets are executed accurately, consistently and on time. While strategic priorities are set by the Senior SEO Strategy & Content Operations Lead, this role is expected to take ownership of execution, proactively identify issues, recommend practical improvements and ensure work is completed to a consistently high standard.

_________________________

CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Newsletter Operations

Responsibilities

--> Own the operational delivery of Privacy Ninja's recurring newsletter programme.

--> Assemble, QA, schedule and publish newsletters according to approved content plans and publishing calendars.

--> Support recurring newsletters including:

* PDPA Organisations

* MCST PDPA

* DPO-as-a-Service

* VAPT

* Phishing Awareness

--> Ensure all newsletters:

* display correctly across devices

* contain working links and CTAs

* follow approved formatting and branding

* are free from formatting or publishing errors

--> Identify missing content, broken links or inconsistencies before publication.

--> Escalate uncertainties relating to messaging or technical accuracy before newsletters are sent.



Accountability: You own the operational quality of every newsletter before it reaches our subscribers.



2. Website Operations & CMS Management

Responsibilities

--> Own the accurate publishing and maintenance of approved website content across Privacy Ninja's WordPress ecosystem.

--> Use WordPress and Elementor to:

* publish blog articles

* update webpages

* make basic layout adjustments

* update images

* maintain internal links

* update CTAs

* perform minor formatting corrections

--> Ensure published content matches approved versions.

--> Review pages after publishing to ensure:

* layouts remain consistent

* desktop and mobile views display correctly

* forms, buttons and navigation function properly

* no formatting or publishing issues exist

--> Identify and resolve simple website issues independently.

--> Escalate development-related issues where required.



Accountability: You own the quality and presentation of published website content. If something breaks during publishing, it is your responsibility to identify it before our visitors do.



3. Social Media Operations

Responsibilities

--> Own the operational delivery of Privacy Ninja's approved social media content.

--> Schedule and publish content across assigned platforms.

--> Prepare posts using approved copy, graphics and templates.

--> Coordinate publishing calendars with marketing campaigns.

--> Monitor scheduled content to ensure successful publication.

--> Escalate issues affecting publishing schedules or campaign quality.



Accountability: You ensure approved content reaches the right audience accurately, consistently and on schedule.



4. Video Content Operations

Responsibilities

--> Assemble short-form educational videos using approved scripts, templates and AI-assisted workflows.

--> Perform quality assurance on:

* captions

* branding

* formatting

* audio

* video completeness

--> Produce recurring educational content for:

* PDPA

* MCST

* VAPT

* Cyber Hygiene

--> Prepare reusable content libraries for future campaigns.

--> Support structured content planning by organising reusable source materials.



Accountability: You own the operational consistency and publishing readiness of all recurring video content.



5. Product & Service Knowledge

Responsibilities

--> Build and maintain a strong understanding of Privacy Ninja's services and solutions.

--> Maintain organised internal reference materials covering:

* products

* services

* FAQs

* differentiators

* positioning

--> Identify outdated or inconsistent information.

--> Coordinate updates with relevant stakeholders.



Accountability: You are expected to understand our business sufficiently to recognise incorrect, incomplete or inconsistent messaging before it reaches customers.



6. Marketing Asset Management

Responsibilities

--> Maintain organised libraries of approved:

* sales decks

* one-pagers

* capability statements

* marketing collateral

* website assets

--> Ensure stakeholders are using the latest approved versions.

--> Coordinate updates when messaging or service offerings change.

--> Support preparation of campaign assets where required.



Accountability: You own the organisation, accessibility and operational readiness of our marketing assets.



7. Brand & Graphic Execution

Responsibilities

--> Own the operational quality of marketing visuals across Privacy Ninja's digital channels.

--> Create and adapt graphics for newsletters, websites, social media, presentations and marketing collateral using approved templates, brand guidelines and AI-assisted design tools.

--> Use AI effectively by providing clear context, prompts and reference materials to generate visuals that align with Privacy Ninja's brand, messaging and quality standards.

--> Review and refine AI-generated graphics to ensure they are:

* visually professional

* brand consistent

* accurate

* appropriate for the intended audience

--> Maintain consistency across all marketing materials in terms of layout, typography, colour palette, spacing and overall presentation.

--> Recognise when design requirements exceed internal capability and coordinate with external designers where necessary.



Accountability: You are not expected to be a professional graphic designer. However, you are expected to exercise good visual judgement and leverage AI effectively to produce high-quality marketing assets that meet Privacy Ninja's brand standards. You should know how to provide AI with the right context, refine its output and recognise when specialist design expertise is required.



8. Operational Improvement & Ownership

Responsibilities

--> Continuously identify opportunities to improve marketing workflows.

--> Recommend improvements to templates, SOPs and recurring processes.

--> Reduce repetitive manual work wherever practical.

--> Maintain organised documentation and operational checklists.

--> Escalate operational risks before they affect delivery.

--> Contribute ideas that improve execution quality, efficiency and consistency.



Accountability: You don't simply execute existing processes—you help improve them.

_______________________

REQUIRED EXPERIENCE

--> 2–4 years of experience in content operations, digital marketing, marketing coordination or similar roles.

--> Hands-on experience using WordPress and Elementor (or similar CMS platforms).

--> Experience managing recurring content calendars and publishing workflows.

--> Comfortable using AI-assisted productivity tools such as ChatGPT, Canva AI or similar tools.

--> Strong written English and attention to detail.

--> Highly organised and comfortable managing multiple recurring deliverables.

_________________________

PROFESSIONAL ATTRIBUTES

We're looking for someone who:

--> Takes ownership rather than waiting for instructions.

--> Pays attention to detail and takes pride in producing accurate, polished work.

--> Thinks proactively and identifies issues before they become problems.

--> Communicates clearly and escalates blockers early.

--> Is dependable, organised and follows through on commitments.

--> Learns quickly and continuously improves the way work is done.

--> Works well independently while collaborating effectively with others.

--> Embraces AI and technology to improve productivity and operational consistency.



______________________________

ABOUT PRIVACY NINJA

Privacy Ninja is a Singapore-based data protection and cybersecurity firm focused on making compliance and security practical for everyday businesses. Through services such as DPO-as-a-Service and vulnerability assessment and penetration testing (VAPT), we help organisations navigate PDPA obligations, strengthen their security posture, and build sustainable compliance practices — without the enterprise-level complexity or cost.



IMPORTANT: At Privacy Ninja, we look for people who embody our Privacy Ninja C.A.R.E. Framework -

– Character, Adaptability, Relational Communication, and Expertise – as these guide how we work and grow together.

This means individuals with strong work ethic, who are approachable, not afraid to admit mistakes, and committed to continuous learning and self-improvement (Character); who are not resistant to adopting new technologies, tools, AI, and automations (Adaptability); capable of clear, empathetic communication with clients and teams (Relational Communication); and who bring deep professional knowledge in the required and relevant skillsets for the role (Expertise). These four pillars define the kind of professionals who thrive in our fast-paced, high-trust environment.



OUR PHILOSOPHY

At Privacy Ninja, technical skills are important, but ownership is non-negotiable.

We value professionals who communicate proactively, identify problems before they become business issues, escalate blockers early, and take responsibility for outcomes rather than simply completing assigned tasks.

If you're looking for a role where you'll simply execute instructions, this position is unlikely to be the right fit.

If you enjoy solving problems, improving systems and taking ownership of meaningful work, we'd love to hear from you.

title: AI Content Creator (Images & Videos)
description:
Company Description:

We are a fast-growing ecommerce company that sells physical products through acquisition platforms

such as Meta Ads, Google Ads, Amazon, Klaviyo, TikTok, Instagram, and more. Our creative team

produces a high volume of direct-response video ads, and AI-generated content sits at the center of that

production.





Role Description:

This is a remote contract role for an AI Video Content Creator. You will work alongside our existing AI

team to generate the AI image and video clips that power our ad creative — every day, at volume.



A typical day looks like this:

- Scripts are written and handed to the team each day. Each script needs a set of AI clips generated for

it, each described in a short brief (roughly 15–40 words) that tells you what the clip needs to show.



- You take that brief, build an image prompt to nail the base frame you want, then build the video

prompt to bring it to life — reprompting and refining until the clip is clean and ad-usable.



- Clips that go into ads get reviewed, and revision notes come back. You turn those revisions around

quickly and correctly.



- As older creative fatigues, you're continuously generating fresh clips to keep the content pipeline full.



The work spans many clip types — product, problem, solution, mechanism, and more creative concepts —

so range and prompting discernment matter as much as raw output.





Qualifications:

- Proven hands-on experience generating AI images and AI videos for ads or social content, using tools

like OpenArt (Seedance, Kling, Veo, Hailuo, etc.) and image models (Nano Banana, GPT Image,

Midjourney, Seedream, etc.).



- Strong prompting skill and discernment — you can get a specific result out of a model, not just

whatever it hands you, and you know how to fight a clip that won't come out right (bad motion, distorted

faces/hands, subject drifting, artifacts).



- Ability to maintain consistency across a sequence — keeping the same character, subject, or product

looking identical from clip to clip (reference images, start/end frames, etc.).



- Comfortable producing high volume — 15+ finished, ad-usable clips per day once ramped.



- Sharp eye for realism: outputs should look real and ad-ready, free of obvious AI artifacts.



- Excellent command of English (C1 level or higher) for clear team communication and following

written direction precisely.



- Availability to work on Eastern Standard Time (EST), with flexibility for tight deadlines and

occasional weekend work during launches.



- Key traits we value: proactiveness, creativity, adaptability, attention to detail, and the discipline to hit

volume without dropping quality.

title: AI T-Shirt Designer – Ideogram & Prompt Engineering Experience Required
description:
We are looking for an experienced AI T-shirt designer for a long-term collaboration in the print-on-demand industry.



You will create original, high-quality T-shirt designs based on reference links, design ideas, slogans, niches, and written instructions. Most projects will include an Amazon reference link that should be used as inspiration for creating a new and improved design.



Requirements

At least 2 years of professional experience creating designs with AI tools

Strong experience using Ideogram or comparable AI design software

Advanced prompt-writing and prompt-engineering skills

Experience creating typography-based and graphic T-shirt designs

Good understanding of composition, typography, colors, readability, and print quality

Ability to recognize and correct typical AI errors

Experience with Photoshop, Illustrator, Photopea, or similar editing software

Reliable, detail-oriented, and able to follow instructions precisely

Good written English communication

Experience with Amazon Merch on Demand or other print-on-demand platforms is a strong advantage

Your Responsibilities

Create original T-shirt designs using Ideogram or other suitable AI tools

Develop effective prompts based on the provided references and instructions

Improve AI-generated results through editing and manual corrections

Check spelling, typography, anatomy, composition, and visual quality

Remove unwanted AI artifacts and background elements

Deliver clean, print-ready PNG files with transparent backgrounds

Ensure every submitted design meets the required quality standard



Quality control is your responsibility. Designs with spelling mistakes, obvious AI errors, poor composition, or technical problems will not be accepted and must be corrected or replaced.



Important



We are not looking for someone who simply generates images and submits the first result.



You must be able to:



Write and refine professional prompts

Select the strongest output

Identify visual problems

Edit and improve the final design

Deliver consistent quality across larger batches



This is intended to become a long-term position with regular design batches for the right person.



How to Apply



Please include the following in your application:



A short description of your AI design experience

Which AI tools you currently use

How long you have been working with Ideogram or similar tools

Examples of AI-generated T-shirt designs you personally created

Examples showing typography-based designs

A brief explanation of your usual workflow, from prompt creation to final quality control

Your price per completed design

Your average number of finished designs per day



Please start your application with the words:



“AI DESIGN SPECIALIST”



Applications without relevant portfolio examples will not be considered.



A paid test batch will be required before starting the long-term collaboration.

title: Virtual Assistant for Growing Online Coaching Company
description:
HALENESS COACHING · OPEN ROLE



Virtual Assistant — Operations & Marketing

Remote — Philippines | Part-to-Full Time | Health & Wellness Coaching



Please read this posting in full before applying. 

Applications that do not follow the instructions below will not be reviewed. 

We are hiring for quality, not quantity.



ABOUT THE COMPANY



Who We Are

Haleness Coaching is an online health and wellness coaching company serving healthcare professional mothers. We help high-achieving women in medicine and healthcare reclaim their metabolic health, hormones, and energy — without sacrificing their careers or their families.



Our founder is a practicing Physician Assistant who has built a systems-based coaching methodology rooted in functional health, nutrition, and hormone optimization. We use Go High Level as our central platform for everything from funnels and pipelines to client communication and automation.



We move fast, we care about precision, and we hold a high standard for the quality of work we put out into the world. We are looking for someone who genuinely matches that.



THE POSITION

What This Role Is



This is not an entry-level assistant role. We need someone who can come in, orient quickly, and execute — independently and with precision. You will own critical operational and marketing functions that directly affect client experience and business growth.



You will work directly with the founder. That means you will see how the business runs, and you will have a real impact on it. The right person will grow significantly in this role over time.



Build and maintain funnels, landing pages, VSLs, and pipelines in Go High Level

Set up and manage automations, workflows, and CRM pipelines in GHL

Use AI tools (including Manus and Claude) daily to complete tasks faster and at a higher quality standard

Create and schedule social media content; manage posting and basic engagement

Design client-facing documents, graphics, and branded assets in Canva

Support lead follow-up and setter activity (if experienced — highly valued)

Organize and maintain the founder's administrative and operational systems

Attend weekly virtual tea
etings and provide status updates proactively

Identify inefficiencies and suggest solutions without being asked



WHAT WE REQUIRE

Qualifications

Marked REQUIRED are non-negotiable. If you do not meet these, please do not apply.



REQUIRED

Go High Level — Advanced

You must have significant hands-on experience building in GHL. This includes funnels, VSLs, landing pages, pipelines, workflows, and automations. You should be able to build and troubleshoot these independently.



REQUIRED

AI Tools — Practical Daily Use

You must actively use AI to work faster and produce higher-quality output. This is not optional. We expect you to use AI to draft, research, edit, and problem-solve — not as a novelty, but as a core part of how you work.



REQUIRED

Prior VA Experience

You must have worked as a VA before — ideally in a health, coaching, or wellness context. You must be able to provide at least one professional reference from a previous role.



REQUIRED

Self-Direction

You do not need to be managed on a task-by-task basis. You take initiative, follow through, and communicate proactively when something is done, stuck, or needs clarity.



REQUIRED

Reliability & Organization

Meetings are attended. Deadlines are met. Nothing falls through the cracks. You track your own work and hold yourself accountable without being reminded.



REQUIRED

English Proficiency

You can communicate clearly and professionally in written and spoken English. This is essential for client-facing materials and team communication.



REQUIRED

Daily Internet & Tech Access

You must have reliable daily access to the internet and a functioning device capable of running GHL, Canva, and video calls without issue.



PREFERRED

Setting Experience

Experience in an appointment-setting or lead engagement role is a significant advantage. If you have this background, make it visible in your application.



PREFERRED

Health Coach / Wellness Industry Background

Experience supporting a health coach, nutritionist, or wellness brand gives you immediate context. This is not required but will move you to the top of the list.



PREFERRED

Canva Proficiency

Experience creating on-brand graphics, carousel posts, and client-facing documents in Canva at a professional level.



PREFERRED

Social Media Content Management

Experience planning, scheduling, and managing content — particularly for Instagram — with an understanding of engagement best practices.



THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR YOU IF…



You have little to no experience using Go High Level in a real business context

You are not actively using AI tools in your daily work and cannot demonstrate experience with Manus or Claude

You are unable to provide a professional reference from a previous VA role

You need constant direction, check-ins, or step-by-step instruction to complete tasks

You treat this as a side job and are not available or responsive during agreed-upon hours

You miss meetings without notice or let tasks slip without communicating

You are applying to multiple generic VA listings and this is not a deliberate choice



WHAT WE OFFER

What You Get



100% remote — work from anywhere

mber went from video editor to creative strategist and doubled their salary. Another started in customer support and now runs the entire customer support team. We promote from within and invest in people who want to grow.

title: Senior SEO Strategy & Content Ops Lead
description:
FULL-TIME, REMOTE-BASED, WORK FROM HOME



Interested candidates, please submit your resume to Privacy Ninja at 
 look forward to welcoming a new member to our team!



Important Notes for Applicants

-> This is a full-time remote position. While the role is remote, the successful candidate is expected to work within Privacy Ninja’s standard working hours of 10:00 AM to 7:00 PM (Singapore Time).

-> Please apply only if you are able to commit to these working hours and the full-time nature of the role.

-> This position includes a 3-month probationary period. A separate probationary remuneration package will apply during this period.

-> All applications will go through an initial screening stage before interviews are scheduled. Candidates who are shortlisted for the interview stage are expected to come prepared to discuss their experience, past work, and approach to SEO and content execution.



ROLE PURPOSE:

To own and drive search visibility, content authority and execution quality across all Privacy Ninja digital properties.



This role is accountable for the performance, quality and continuous improvement of our search ecosystem across traditional search engines and emerging AI-powered search experiences (e.g. Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT and Gemini). 



Beyond technical SEO expertise, we are looking for someone who takes ownership, communicates proactively, exercises sound judgement and drives initiatives through to completion with minimal supervision. This is a high-ownership individual contributor role. You will not manage people, but you will be expected to own outcomes.



CORE RESPONSIBILITIES



1. Ownership, Planning & Decision-Making

Responsibilities:

--> Take ownership of Privacy Ninja's SEO performance across all assigned digital properties (10 websites).

--> Independently identify priorities, risks, and opportunities, and areas for improvement without waiting for instructions.

--> Recommend practical solutions supported by SEO data, business context, and commercial impact.

--> Make informed decisions on what should be prioritised, improved, refreshed or retired based on business objectives and performance data. 

--> Escalate blockers, risks or delays early rather than allowing work to stall.

--> Drive initiatives through to completion and ensure agreed actions are followed through.

--> Maintain visibility of progress through proactive communication with stakeholders.

--> Take accountability not only for completing work, but for achieving measurable business outcomes.



2. SEO Search Strategy & Visibility

Responsibilities:

--> Own the SEO strategy across Privacy Ninja's digital ecosystem, currently comprising 10 WordPress websites with future expansion planned. 

--> Develop and maintain topic clusters that strengthen topical authority across key business areas, including:

* Singapore PDPA compliance

* Data Protection Officer (DPO) services

* Vulnerability Assessment & Penetration Testing (VAPT)

* Cybersecurity

* MCST compliance

* SaaS products and future digital initiatives

--> Optimise search visibility across:

* Google Search

* Google AI Overviews

* AI-powered discovery platforms (e.g. ChatGPT, Gemini and other emerging answer engines)

--> Identify opportunities to expand Privacy Ninja's search presence through strategic content planning, search intent analysis and authority building.

--> Continuously evaluate competitor movements and recommend initiatives that improve our search positioning.



3. Content Strategy & Editorial Excellence

Responsibilities:

--> Determine content priorities across all 10 websites based on business goals and search opportunities.

--> D
 what content should be:

* Created

* Updated

* Consolidated

* Retired

--> Identify keyword cannibalisation, content decay and opportunities for content expansion.

--> Ensure all published content meets Privacy Ninja standards for:

* Technical accuracy

* Regulatory appropriateness

* Readability

* Authority

* Trustworthiness

--> Review content before publication to ensure it is optimised for both traditional SEO and AI-powered search experiences.



4. Website Governance & Technical SEO

Responsibilities:

--> Own the overall operational health, technical SEO and user experience of Privacy Ninja's WordPress websites (10 websites). 

--> Maintain SEO best practices across all websites, including:

* Site architecture

* Internal linking

* XML sitemaps

* Canonicalisation

* Schema markup

* Metadata

* On-page optimisation

* Mobile responsiveness

* Basic website performance hygiene

--> Perform routine website updates using WordPress and Elementor, including:

* Publishing and updating content

* Basic layout and formatting adjustments

* CTA and navigation updates

* Image optimisation

* Internal link management

* Minor UI/content corrections that do not require custom development

--> Regularly review websites to ensure:

* Pages display correctly across desktop and mobile devices.

* Layouts remain visually consistent.

* Buttons, forms and navigation function as intended.

* Content is accurate, current and aligned with Privacy Ninja's standards.

* User experience is not negatively impacted by website changes.

--> Proactively identify and resolve technical SEO or website quality issues wherever possible.

--> Coordinate with developers when custom development or advanced technical support is required, while remaining accountable for the overall outcome.

--> Ensure all 10 websites remain technically sound, search-friendly and aligned with Privacy Ninja's business objectives.



5. Performance Analysis & Continuous Improvement

Responsibilities:

--> Monitor rankings, indexing, traffic trends and overall search performance using SEO platforms such as SEMrush or equivalent.

--> Analyse competitor activity, keyword performance and emerging search trends.

--> Translate data into meaningful recommendations that support business objectives.

--> Measure the effectiveness of implemented improvements and refine strategies based on results.

--> Recommend what should continue, improve or stop based on performance insights.



6. AI-Assisted Search & Workflow Optimisation

Responsibilities:

--> Stay current with developments in AI-powered search, including:

* Google AI Overviews

* Answer Engine Optimisation (AEO)

* Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO)

* Emerging search technologies

--> Use AI responsibly to improve research, content development and SEO workflows.



NOTE: This role is expected to leverage AI as a productivity and research tool. It is not responsible for developing AI software or building AI systems.



7. Reporting & Business Reviews

Responsibilities:

--> Own fortnightly reporting to the CEO and COO.

--> Present clear updates on:

* SEO performance

* Website health

* Content effectiveness

* Emerging risks

* Strategic recommendations

--> Translate technical findings into practical business decisions and prioritised action plans.

--> Communicate progress proactively and ensure leadership has visibility into priorities, risks and expected outcomes.

_________________________

REQUIRED EXPERIENCE:

--> Minimum 3 years of experience in SEO, organic search or content strategy.

--> Demonstrated experience owning SEO outcomes rather than solely producing content.

--> Strong understanding of:

* Technical SEO

* Search intent

* Content clustering

* Keyword research

* On-page optimisation

* Website analytics

--> Experience using SEO platforms such as SEMrush (minimally). Other tools will be a plus.

--> Experience working with WordPress websites.

--> Familiarity with AI-powered search trends, including Google AI Overviews, AEO and GEO.

--> Comfortable working independently with minimal supervision in a remote environment.

_________________________

Professional Attributes

--> We're looking for someone who:

--> Leverages on the experience to propose / obtain management buy-in to execute.

--> Notices problems before they become business issues.

--> Escalates blockers early and communicates proactively.

--> Thinks critically and proposes solutions rather than simply identifying problems.

--> Follows through until initiatives are completed successfully.

--> Is organised, dependable and accountable for outcomes.

--> Learns quickly and embraces new tools, technologies and ways of working.

--> Maintains high standards of professionalism, quality and continuous improvement.

--> Works collaboratively while remaining highly self-directed.



______________________________

ABOUT PRIVACY NINJA

Privacy Ninja is a Singapore-based data protection and cybersecurity firm focused on making compliance and security practical for everyday businesses. Through services such as DPO-as-a-Service and vulnerability assessment and penetration testing (VAPT), we help organisations navigate PDPA obligations, strengthen their security posture, and build sustainable compliance practices — without the enterprise-level complexity or cost.



IMPORTANT: At Privacy Ninja, we look for people who embody our Privacy Ninja C.A.R.E. Framework -

 – Character, Adaptability, Relational Communication, and Expertise – as these guide how we work and grow together.

This means individuals with strong work ethic, who are approachable, not afraid to admit mistakes, and committed to continuous learning and self-improvement (Character); who are not resistant to adopting new technologies, tools, AI, and automations (Adaptability); capable of clear, empathetic communication with clients and teams (Relational Communication); and who bring deep professional knowledge in the required and relevant skillsets for the role (Expertise). These four pillars define the kind of professionals who thrive in our fast-paced, high-trust environment.



OUR PHILOSOPHY

At Privacy Ninja, technical skills are important, but ownership is non-negotiable.

We value professionals who communicate proactively, identify problems before they become business issues, escalate blockers early, and take responsibility for outcomes rather than simply completing assigned tasks.

If you're looking for a role where you'll simply execute instructions, this position is unlikely to be the right fit.

If you enjoy solving problems, improving systems and taking ownership of meaningful work, we'd love to hear from you.

title: TikTok + Instagram Growth Operator (Social Media Manager, Multi Account) | Full-Time | $500-$1,500+/mo USD
description:
Pay: guaranteed monthly base of $500 to $800 USD depending on experience, plus uncapped performance bonuses.

Proven multi-account operators start between $1000 and $1,500. Paid weekly.

Platforms: TikTok and Instagram, multiple accounts, 5 to 10 cloud phones controlled from your computer.

Schedule: full-time, 8+ hours per day, 7 days per week, fixed schedule on US hours.



We are an established, profitable company. We run a growing network of TikTok and Instagram accounts in one specific niche, and we go deep on it. We are hiring a full-time operator to run 5 to 10 cloud phones from a computer and make accounts grow fast. Anyone can post content. You are there to make accounts take off. You pick the right clips from our content library, you ride the right trends, you watch what competitor pages are doing, and you keep every account healthy and posting daily. We supply the content, the playbook, the cloud phones and full training. The judgment calls are yours.



We Only Hire Top Players



Let's be direct. We are not interested in average applicants, and most applications will not move forward. We want it that way. We would rather leave the seat empty than fill it with someone ordinary. We want A-players and nothing else, because we run A-systems and pay A-salaries. If you are genuinely good, this works completely in your favor. You get real responsibility fast, and we build the team around people who deliver, for the long term. We are a serious company with proven results over several years.



This Is Not a Posting Job



A poster uploads what they are told and logs it in a sheet. A marketer looks at 30 clips and knows which two can hit 500,000 views, and can tell you why. We are hiring the second one. You will follow our process, but inside that process you make real calls every day: which clips to run, which hook to use, which trend to jump on, and which account needs attention before a small problem turns into a dead one.



What Your Day Actually Looks Like



The role runs on 5 to 10 cloud phones every day, all controlled from your computer through our systems. We provide the software and the access. Account health comes first: anything flagged, anything with reach behaving strangely, gets handled before everything else. Then overnight numbers on both platforms, and a scan of the pages we track to see what is popping. From there it is the content library. Pick the clips you believe can break out, make light CapCut edits where needed (trims, text overlays, covers), post on schedule across all accounts, run engagement, log the numbers, and send a clean report. About twice a week, you flag something nobody asked you for. A format that is working for competitors. An account that needs a different angle. That is the job.



Two Kinds of People Get Hired



Either you have done this before. You have run multiple TikTok or Instagram accounts at the same time, whether agency work, 
 or theme pages, or multi-account setups. You know what account warm-up feels like, you have dealt with restrictions, and you have numbers you can show.



Or you have not, but you should have. No direct experience, but you have a marketing brain. You watch a For You page and understand why things go viral. You are sharp and you learn fast. We have full training, SOPs and a content library. We can teach the process. We cannot teach judgment or drive.



Be honest in the application about which one you are. We hire both. What we never hire is someone pretending experience they do not have.



What We Provide



Day one you get onboarding documents, step by step SOPs, a content library, the cloud phone setup, training calls, and a manager who answers. You will never be guessing what to do. The SOPs cover the process. What we hire you for is everything the SOPs cannot cover: judgment.



Formal scope: 5 to 10 accounts across TikTok and Instagram, run on cloud phones from your computer, end to end. Content selection from our library, light CapCut edits, posting, engagement, account health monitoring, daily reporting.



What You Need



8 hours minimum per day, 7 days per week. The accounts post every day, weekends included, so the operation runs daily too. The trade-off is stability: same fixed hours every day, so you can build your life around it, and the pay lands every week.

A fixed schedule on US hours. This is not flexible. If you are in the Philippines, expect an early morning start.

A solid computer (8GB+ RAM, SSD preferred) and fast, stable internet (50Mbps+ with a backup plan). That is the whole hardware list. The phones are cloud phones we provide, you control them on screen, so you do not need any phone of your own.

Strong written English. Captions, reports and daily communication all depend on it.

You can follow a detailed process exactly, and you know when something looks off and it is time to speak up instead of blindly executing.

You will own your set of accounts end to end. You report numbers daily, but nobody hands you a script for what to pick. Your accounts, your calls, your results.

What We Pay



Your base is guaranteed: $500 to $800 USD per month to start, set by experience. Proven multi-account operators start between $1000 and $1,500. On top of base, your pay grows on two tracks. Base raises as you take on more accounts, and uncapped performance bonuses tied to how your accounts actually perform: views, growth, account health. When an account you run starts printing views, you feel it in your pay. The range is open ended. Your output sets the ceiling.



One thing to understand: the base is there because everyone feels safer with a guaranteed floor. The real money is in performance. Operators who adapt to the workflow fast and take the craft seriously can realistically double or triple their base between bonuses and raises. If that sounds like you, apply. That is exactly who we built this pay structure for.



We pay weekly, every week, on schedule. The exact payment method is spelled out inside the application, and you confirm it works for you before any interview.



We are not price-shopping. The $500 floor exists for unproven beginners we train from zero, and nobody good stays at the floor for long.



Where This Can Go



Operator, then Senior Operator with more accounts and a higher base, then Team Lead where you train and run other operators. The training materials already exist, you would own them. And it does not stop at this department: people who prove they can run things get promoted into other parts of the company, with bigger scope and better pay. Several people on our current team started exactly where you would be starting. They stayed because the pay lands every week without fail and the role keeps growing.



We are scaling hard. The process, the system and the knowledge already exist and already work, we are hiring to run a working machine at higher volume. We only bring on people with the same ambition. For those people we think this is the best role of its kind on this board, and the paid trial week exists so you do not have to take our word for it.



Who Should NOT Apply



You want a list of tasks to execute and nothing more. This role requires opinions about which content will perform, and why.

Running 5 to 10 cloud phones' worth of accounts sounds stressful to you instead of interesting.

You cannot commit to 8+ hours per day, 7 days per week, on a fixed US-hours schedule.

You plan to run this alongside another real job or anything that takes serious hours.

You would use AI to write your application. We have read hundreds of AI-written applications. They all sound the same, and we reject them. Write short and specific, in your own words. A long polished essay is the fastest way to get skipped.

Slow computer, unstable internet, no backup plan for outages.

You are an average performer looking for a safe seat. We only move forward with top players.

How to Apply



There is one way in: the application form. Do not send us a message here, messages are not reviewed.







The form takes about 45 minutes for most people. No video, no assignments, just precise questions answered in your own words. We made it thorough on purpose, because the form is the first test of the job: whether you can follow instructions closely and still think for yourself. Some questions contain specific instructions inside them. Follow them exactly.



Partway through the form, we tell you exactly what the niche is and what the accounts promote. If it is not for you at that point, you can say so and stop there, no hard feelings.



What happens next: every completed application gets a yes or no decision within 5 business days. We reply either way. Shortlisted candidates get a paid trial week before any final decision.

title: Part-Time Spanish-Speaking Instagram VA
description:
About Us



Caribico is a registered nonprofit building a global network of university and regional chapters for Caribbean and diaspora youth, guided by one idea: One Caribbean, One Future. We're now expanding into Spanish-speaking communities, and we're looking for a reliable, detail-oriented person with fluent written Spanish to help bring new chapters to life on Instagram and connect with students who want to be part of the movement.



The Role



You'll work from a clear, step-by-step playbook we provide — no guesswork. One chapter at a time, you'll take a brand-new Instagram account from setup all the way to a live application campaign over roughly a 2–3 week cycle. Everything you post and send for these chapters is in Spanish, so native or near-native written Spanish is essential. Once a chapter attracts its first round of applicants, you hand the list to our team and move on to the next one. No face on camera, and no prior experience in our world required — if you follow instructions carefully and show up consistently, we'll teach you the rest.



What You'll Do (per chapter)



Set up the chapter's Instagram profile using our brand assets and Spanish bio template

Find and follow the right students at the target university — we tell you exactly which groups and accounts to target

Engage genuinely in Spanish: thoughtful comments, replies, and DMs (we give you templates to personalize — never copy-paste spam)

Publish a short set of posts from our Spanish templates, including the application-drive post

Build a simple Google Form from our template

Reach out directly to promising prospects and invite them to apply

Track applicants in a shared sheet and pass the shortlist to our team

Keep accounts healthy: capped daily follows, natural pacing, all manual — no bots, no automation



What We're Looking For
